items.description: An aberrant sorcery, discovered along with red glintstone by those exiled to the north for their crimes. Summons large thorns from a whorl of blood shed by one's own hand in penance for sins. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The Academy reviles this sorcery, which draws its power from faith.
items.effect: Summons thorns from a whorl of your own blood.

items.name: Brick Hammer
items.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

items.name: Broadsword
items.description: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

items.name: Buckler
items.description: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.

items.name: Budding Cave Moss
items.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, speckled with tiny, yellow flowers. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Budding Horn
items.description: A rarely-seen specimen of a young, budding horn. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting herbivorous beasts.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Bull-goat Armor
items.description: Great Horned Tragoth's armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

items.name: Bull-goat Gauntlets
items.description: Great Horned Tragoth's gauntlets. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

items.name: Bull-goat Greaves
items.description: Great Horned Tragoth's greaves. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

items.name: Bull-goat Helm
items.description: Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

items.name: Bull-goat's Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting the horns of a bull-goat. Raises poise.
items.effect: Raises Poise

items.name: Burn O Flame!
items.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
items.effect: Raises a series of flame pillars around caster

items.name: Burred Bolt
items.description: Bolt covered in thorns. One of the most horrific weapons used in the Shattering. Afflicts with blood loss.

items.name: Butchering Knife
items.description: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.  Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

items.name: Caestus
items.description: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

items.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
items.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.

items.name: Cane Sword
items.description: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.  Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.

items.name: Cannon Of Haima
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency. Drawn from the conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.
items.effect: Lobs an explosive magic projectile in an arc

items.name: Carian Filigreed Crest
items.description: A talisman adorned with the royal crest.
items.effect: Lowers FP consumed by skills

items.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
items.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

items.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
items.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.

items.name: Carian Greatsword
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.
items.effect: Performs sweeping slash using magical greatsword

items.name: Carian Inverted Statue
items.description: Statuette of a scholar, with ground and sky inverted.
items.effect: Key revealing the hidden form of Carian Study Hall

items.name: Carian Knight Armor
items.description: Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Carian Knight Armor

items.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen,  were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all decorated heroes, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Helm
items.description: Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight's Shield
items.description: A teardrop-shaped shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family. Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?

items.name: Carian Knight's Sword
items.description: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone.  Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

items.name: Carian Phalanx
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Forms a defensive arch of numerous magic glintblades

items.name: Carian Piercer
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Impales foes with magical greatsword

items.name: Carian Regal Scepter
items.description: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

items.name: Carian Retaliation
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Dispels enemy spells and retaliates with glintblades

items.name: Carian Slicer
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Performs swift sweeping slash using magical sword

items.name: Cave Moss
items.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves. Material used in crafting items. A fundamental ingredient for medicinal boluses.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
items.description: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

items.name: Celebrant's Rib-rake
items.description: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

items.name: Celebrant's Sickle
items.description: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

items.name: Celebrant's Skull
items.description: Large bludgeon ecorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics.  Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.   The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

items.name: Celestial Dew
items.description: A hidden Tear found in the Eternal City. Also known as a Night Tear.
items.effect: Carry out Absolution at the Church of Vows

items.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
items.description: A medallion with cerulean amber inlaid. Boosts maximum FP.
items.effect: Raises maximum FP

items.name: Cerulean Crystal Tear
items.description: A special crystallization formed over the course of many moons within a tear of life, a blessing of the Erdtree. Can be mixed in a flask of wondrous physick. The resulting concoction restores 20 half of one's max FP.
items.effect: Restores half of total FP in mixed physick.

items.name: Cerulean Hidden Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Eliminates all FP consumption in mixed physick

items.name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
items.description: A cerulean-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts FP restoration from the Flask of Cerulean Tears.
items.effect: Boosts FP restoration from Flask of Cerulean Tears

items.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
items.description: Blue scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

items.name: Chain Armor
items.description: Armor made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

items.name: Chain Coif
items.description: Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

items.name: Chain-draped Tabard
items.description: Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Chain Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

items.name: Chain Leggings
items.description: Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

items.name: Chainlink Flail
items.description: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

items.name: Champion Bracers
items.description: Bracers reserved for the bandlands' bravest.  Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes.  Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Champion Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Champion Headband
items.description: Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Champion Pauldron
items.description: Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Chrysalids' Memento
items.description: Memento left by the chrysalids sacrificed for grafting. A brooch wrapped in red velvet. Traces of blood are visible.
items.effect: Broach wrapped in red velvet

items.name: Cinquedea
items.description: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.

items.name: Cipher Pata
items.description: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

items.name: Clarifying Boluses
items.description: Yellow boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates madness buildup. Madness accumulates slowly, inflicting heavy damage and reducing FP once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such events.
items.effect: Alleviates madness buildup

items.name: Clarifying Cured Meat
items.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a purple medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts focus. Higher focus helps to mitigate the buildup of sleep and madness.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts focus

items.name: Clarifying Horn Charm
items.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises focus. (Focus governs resistance to sleep and madness.)
items.effect: Raises Focus

items.name: Clarifying White Cured Meat
items.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a purple medicinal solution. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts focus

items.name: Claw Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a claw and an assassin. Enhances jump attacks.
items.effect: Enhances jump attacks.

items.name: Clawmark Seal
items.description: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

items.name: Clayman Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two claymen. Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.
items.effect: Summons two clayman spirits

items.name: Clayman's Harpoon
items.description: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

items.name: Claymore
items.description: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust making this a versatile weapon.

items.name: Cleanrot Armor
items.description: Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Armor

items.name: Cleanrot Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Greaves
items.description: Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

items.name: Cleanrot Helm
items.description: Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

items.name: Cleanrot Helm (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Helm

items.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay Ashes
items.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of the Cleanrot Knight Finlay. Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable act of heroism carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree. She managed the feat alone, fending off all manner of foes along the way.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

items.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
items.description: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.

items.name: Cleanrot Spear
items.description: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

items.name: Clinging Bone
items.description: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

items.name: Cloth Garb
items.description: Clothing made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

items.name: Cloth Trousers
items.description: Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

items.name: Club
items.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

items.name: Coded Sword
items.description: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

items.name: Coil Shield
items.description: An extremely odd shield adorned with a coiled bronze snake. An excellent choice for attention-seekers. This Shield provides an effective defense against poison - after all, how does one poison a poisonous snake?

items.name: Collapsing Stars
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.
items.effect: Pulls foes toward caster with gravity projectile volley

items.name: Comet
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a great magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The greatest of the Karolos Conspectus's sorceries, that only a very few sorcerers have ever mastered.
items.effect: Fires a great magic comet

items.name: Comet Azur
items.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Azur, primeval sorcerer. Fires a tremendous comet in a torrent akin to the distant starry expanse, the place said to be the origin of glintstone. Hold to continue releasing the sorcery's power. When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw darkness. He was left both bewitched and fearful of the abyss.
items.effect: Fires a tremendous comet within a starry torrent

items.name: Commander's Standard
items.description: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.

items.name: Commoner's Garb
items.description: Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

items.name: Commoner's Garb (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Garb

items.name: Commoner's Headband
items.description: A headband with the cloth removed. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

items.name: Commoner's Headband (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Headband

items.name: Commoner's Shoes
items.description: Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
items.description: Garb with a modest cloth cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Simple Garb

items.name: Companion Jar
items.description: A talisman given by the jars to their friends. Raises potency of thrown jars.
items.effect: Raises potency of throwing pots

items.name: Composite Bow
items.description: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

items.name: Concealing Veil
items.description: Talisman put together from dark cloth with a lustrous sheen
items.effect: Conceals wearer while crouching away from foes

items.name: Confessor Armor
items.description: Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Confessor Armor

items.name: Confessor Boots
items.description: Leather boots of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Gloves
items.description: Black leather gloves of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Hood
items.description: Black hood for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Hood (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Confessor Hood

items.name: Consort's Mask
items.description: Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the image of a foreign queen.

items.name: Consort's Robe
items.description: Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Consort's Trousers
items.description: Fine white trousers, perfectly suited for wearing beneath a silk robe.

items.name: Conspectus Scroll
items.effect: Give to Sorceress Sellen to unlock Glintstone Cometshard and Star Shower

items.name: Corhyn's Robe
items.description: Robe of Corhyn the cleric. Even after exile, Corhyn refused to recant his prophecies. And for this, he was blessed with the guidance of grace. Since then, the cart wheel draped on his neck has served as a reminder. That true guidance awaits those with iron wills. Those with unwavering faith.

items.name: Crab Eggs
items.description: Eggs of lare crabs which dwell in the shallows. Materials used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Cracked Crystal
items.description: A cracked, impure, degraded, and altogether unremarkable crystal. Material used for crafting items
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Cracked Pot
items.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken.
items.effect: Container required for crafting cracked pot items

items.name: Crafting Kit
items.description: Leather bag containing a pestle and mortar, small blade, and various other tools. Enables item crafting from the main menu. Provides both means to fight and means to survive.
items.effect: Enables the practice of item Crafting

items.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
items.description: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a  candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

items.name: Crepus's Black-key Crossbow
items.description: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

items.name: Crepus's Vial
items.description: Small mysterious bottle with a dark mist sealed within.
items.effect: Eliminates all sound made by the wearer during movement

items.name: Crescent Moon Axe
items.description: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

items.name: Crimson Amber Medallion
items.description: A medallion with Crimson amber inlaid. Boosts maximum HP. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside
items.effect: Raises maximum HP

items.name: Crimson Bubbletear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction automatically heals one's HP in the moment before death. However, this effect only occurs once, and will expire after a certain duration.
items.effect: Restores HP when near death in mixed physick.

items.name: Crimson Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction restores half of one's maximum HP.
items.effect: Restores half of total HP in mixed physick

items.name: Crimson Hood
items.description: A hooded cloak of vivid crimson.  Worn by expatriates royalty.  Increases vigor.

items.name: Crimson Seed Talisman
items.description: A crimson-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts HP restoration from the Flask of Crimson Tears.
items.effect: Boosts HP regeneration from Flask of Crimson Tears

items.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
items.description: Red scarab worn directly on the head. The red scarabs roll clumps of crimson tears during their labors.

items.name: Crimsonburst Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's
items.effect: Steadily restores HP for a time in mixed physick

items.name: Crimsonspill Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises one's maximum HP.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts max HP in mixed physick

items.name: Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction converts incoming damage into recovered HP instead. However, physical damage cannot be converted. This effect is only brief and will quickly expire.
items.effect: Converts damage received into HP in mixed physick.

items.name: Cross-naginata
items.description: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana. A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.

items.name: Crossed-tree Towershield
items.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel

items.name: Crucible Axe Armor
items.description: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Axe Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Crucible Axe Armor

items.name: Crucible Axe Helm
items.description: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
items.description: A talisman fashioned from feathers that embody the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
items.effect: Improves dodge rolling but increases damage taken

items.name: Crucible Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

items.name: Crucible Greaves
items.description: Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

items.name: Crucible Hornshield
items.description: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn. An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.

items.name: Crucible Knot Talisman
items.description: A talisman fashioned from a bony knot that embodies that aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
items.effect: Reduces damage and impact of headshots

items.name: Crucible Scale Talisman
items.description: A talisman fashioned from a scale that embodies the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
items.effect: Reduces damage taken from critical hits

items.name: Crucible Tree Armor
items.description: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Siluria and her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Tree Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Crucible Tree Armor

items.name: Crucible Tree Helm
items.description: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crystal Barrage
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Fires a volley of glintstone crystal shards

items.name: Crystal Bud
items.description: A young plant, crystalized before it could mature. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Crystal Burst
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging increases potency. A sorcery of the Crystal Cadre, a group of sorcerers who pursued the wisdom of stone - the secrets locked in the faint cogitation of the Crystalians.
items.effect: Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards

items.name: Crystal Cave Moss
items.description: Faintly luminescent moss that grows in dark caves, laced with fine crystals. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Crystal Dart
items.description: Throwing knife chiseled from impure crystal. Craftable item. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to deal magic damage. Long ago, it is said that a golem crafter employed a similar crystal tool.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw to inflict magic damage.

items.name: Crystal Knife
items.description: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners.  Used as a tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

items.name: Crystal Release
items.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it to scour a wide area with a violent rain of crystal shards. This sorcery is used by high-ranking adepts among the Crystalians. Some also call this sorcery "the Crystal Sun."
items.effect: Scours area with violent rain of crystal shards

items.name: Crystal Spear
items.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

items.name: Crystal Staff
items.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceris. The Crystalian's faint cognition is know as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be weilded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.

items.name: Crystal Sword
items.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

items.name: Crystal Torrent
items.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.
items.effect: Creates crystal mass that fires stream of crystal shards

items.name: Crystalian Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian. Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.
items.effect: Summons Crystalian spirit

items.name: Cuckoo Glintstone
items.description: Lump of broken glintstone enwreathed with magic power. A "faux sorcery"used by the Knights of the Cuckoo. Craftable item. Launched straight ahead, using FP. A magic bolt springs forth from the point of impact
items.effect: Uses FP to produce a magic bolt

items.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
items.description: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Cuckoo Knight Armor

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Helm
items.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

items.name: Cuckoo Surcoat
items.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone. To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

items.name: Cure Poison
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Cures Poison ailment and reduces poison build-up.

items.name: Cursed-blood Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of the Lord of Blood. Throw at enemies to douse them in accursed blood, causing summoned spirits to assail them with a rabid fervor. A childhood memory of the Lord of Blood.
items.effect: Throw to douse enemy with accursed blood.

items.name: Cursemark Of Death
items.description: Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede.
items.effect: Cursemark carved into Lunar Princess Ranni's discarded flesh

items.name: Curved Club
items.description: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

items.name: Curved Great Club
items.description: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

items.name: Curved Sword Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a curved sword and a swordsman. Enhances guard counters.
items.effect: Enhances guard counters.

items.name: Daedicar's Woe
items.description: Disturbing likeness of a woman whose skin was flayed. She smiles with a serene tenderness.
items.effect: Increases damage taken

items.name: Dagger
items.description: A standard dagger with a straight blade.  Though modest in reach and capacity fo harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.

items.name: Dagger Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a dagger and a surgeon. Enhances critical hits.
items.effect: Enhances critical hits.

items.name: Dappled Cured Meat
items.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts Immunity, Robustness, and Focus

items.name: Dappled White Cured Meat
items.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a dappled medicinal solution. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts immunity, robustness, and focus

items.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
items.description: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

items.name: Dark Moon Ring
items.description: Ring depicting a leaden full moon. Symbolic of a cold oath, the ring is supposed to be given by Lunar Princess Ranni to her consort.
items.effect: Ring of Lunar Princess Ranni's cold oath

items.name: Darkness
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the
items.effect: Creates area of darkness that conceals caster

items.name: Death Lightning
items.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon
items.effect: Strikes surroundings with storm of death lightning

items.name: Death Ritual Spear
items.description: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

items.name: Death's Poker
items.description: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

items.name: Deathbed Dress
items.description: Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead. Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer. The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while still sharing her warmth.

items.name: Deathbed Smalls
items.description: Skirt worn by Phia, the Deathbed Companion.

items.name: Deathroot
items.description: A source that gives rise to Those Who Live in Death.
items.effect: Beast Clergyman seeks and devours these

items.name: Dectus Medallion (left)
items.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.
items.effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

items.name: Dectus Medallion (right)
items.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.
items.effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Dectus

items.name: Demi-human Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans.
items.effect: Summons five demi-human spirits

items.name: Demi-human Queen's Staff
items.description: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence. Sneered at by fools in the academy.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer. Depraved perfumers practice their art for themselves alone. Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Depraved Perfumer Carmaan

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Gloves
items.description: Gloves worn by depraved perfumers.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf
items.description: Headscarf worn by depraved perfumers.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
items.description: Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is  what earned them their name.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Depraved Perfumer Robe

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Trousers
items.description: Trousers worn by depraved perfumers.

items.name: Deserter's Cookbook [1]
items.description: A fugitive deserter's record of crafting techniques. Contains knowledge for surviving in the face of utter scarcity.

items.name: Deserter's Cookbook [2]
items.description: A fugitive deserter's record of crafting techniques. Contains knowledge for surviving in the face of utter scarcity.

items.name: Devourer's Scepter
items.description: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of  Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.

items.name: Dewkissed Herba
items.description: A herb that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts dexterity in mixed physick

items.name: Diallos's Mask
items.description: Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails.

items.name: Digger's Staff
items.description: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.   Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries

items.name: Dirty Chainmail
items.description: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefits worthy of note.

items.name: Discarded Palace Key
items.description: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.
items.effect: Key to treasure chest for Carian Princesses

items.name: Discus Of Light
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
items.effect: Fires ring of light before the caster

items.name: Dismounter
items.description: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

items.name: Distinguished Greatshield
items.description: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

items.name: Divine Fortification
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Increases holy damage negation.

items.name: Dolores The Sleeping Arrow Puppet
items.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Solores the Sleeping Arrow

items.name: Dragon Communion Seal
items.description: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.

items.name: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
items.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
items.effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

items.name: Dragon Greatclaw
items.description: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning,and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

items.name: Dragon Halberd
items.description: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

items.name: Dragon Heart
items.description: Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. It has a bizarre shape, mottled by gravel, and it continues to beat vivaciously. An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours. While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.
items.effect: Gain power of the dragon at the Dragon Communion altar.

items.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
items.description: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

items.name: Dragon Towershield
items.description: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.

items.name: Dragonbolt Blessing
items.description: Superior incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons lightning to bolster the caster's body. Attacks become easier to deflect and resistance to all ailments is increased. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Only those loved by dragons can survive the ordeal of cladding their bodies in lightning.
items.effect: Bolsters caster's body with lightning

items.name: Dragonclaw
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels dragon to rend foes with dragon claws

items.name: Dragonclaw Shield
items.description: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Edrtree. Imbued with lightning.

items.name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
items.description: Legendary talisman of wrought iron depicting a massive ancient dragon. Enormously boosts physical damage negation.
items.effect: Enormously boosts physical damage negation

items.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
items.description: Wrought iron talisman depicting a trio of ancient dragons. Boosts physical damage negation.
items.effect: Boosts physical damage negation

items.name: Dragonfire
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels dragon to spew flame breath

items.name: Dragonice
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels dragon to spew icy breath

items.name: Dragonmaw
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels dragon to bite foes before caster

items.name: Dragonscale Blade
items.description: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

items.name: Dragonwound Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of gravels stones. Craftable item.
items.effect: Coats armament, granting special dragon attacks

items.name: Drake Knight Armor
items.description: Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partake of communion. The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.

items.name: Drake Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Armor

items.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Black iron gauntlets worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

items.name: Drake Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

items.name: Drake Knight Helm
items.description: Black iron helm worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

items.name: Drake Knight Helm (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Helm.

items.name: Drawing-room Key
items.description: Key to Volcano Manor's drawing room.
items.effect: Key to the Volcano Manor drawing room

items.name: Drawstring Blood Grease
items.effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting blood loss

items.name: Drawstring Fire Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. A smallish lump with a short string attached. Quickly coats armament, inflicting fire damage. However, the effects are only brief.
items.effect: Quickly coats weapon, inflicting  Fire Damage

items.name: Drawstring Holy Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of holy resonant materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting holy damage, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.
items.effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting holy damage

items.name: Drawstring Lightning Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump.
items.effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting lightning damage.

items.name: Drawstring Magic Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting magic damage, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.
items.effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting magic damage

items.name: Drawstring Rot Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of rotten materials. Craftable item. A short string is attached to this lump. Quickly coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.
items.effect: Quickly coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot, but with a brief effect, owing to its small size.

items.name: Duelist Greataxe
items.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

items.name: Duelist Greaves
items.description: Greaves encircles by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Duelist Helm
items.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Duelist's Furled Finger
items.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for competitive multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. The bronze adornments are the mark of a duelist.
items.effect: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

items.name: Dung Eater Puppet
items.description: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.
items.effect: Summons spirit of the Dung Eater

items.name: Dwelling Arrow
items.description: Arrow in which the spirits of small animals are thought to dwell.

items.name: Eccentric's Armor
items.description: Unusually colorful armor. Worn by the knight Jerren. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath

items.name: Eccentric's Breeches
items.description: The knight Jerren's breeches. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

items.name: Eccentric's Hood
items.description: A pointy, ragged hood. Worn by the knight Jerren. The hood hides an aged, bearded mask. Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

items.name: Eccentric's Hood (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Eccentric's Hood

items.name: Eccentric's Manchettes
items.description: The knight Jerren's manchettes. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
items.description: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay. No skill. This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
items.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.

items.name: Eclipse Shotel
items.description: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

items.name: Ekzyke's Decay
items.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.
items.effect: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above.

items.name: Ekzykes's Decay
items.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.
items.effect: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above

items.name: Elden Lord Armor
items.description: Armor of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

items.name: Elden Lord Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Elden Lord Armor

items.name: Elden Lord Bracers
items.description: Bracers of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

items.name: Elden Lord Crown
items.description: Crown of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

items.name: Elden Lord Greaves
items.description: Greaves of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

items.name: Elden Remembrance
items.description: Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Elden Stars
items.description: This legendary incantation is the most ancient of those that derive from the Erdtree.
items.effect: Creates a steam of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

items.name: Electrify Armament
items.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
items.effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

items.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
items.description: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

items.name: Entwining Umbilical Cord
items.description: Mysterious circular object that's oddly warped. Changes the demeanour of the wearer's actions.
items.effect: Changes demeanour of wearer's actions

items.name: Envoy Crown
items.description: The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys. Densely wrapped in several layers of cloth. Raises the potency of bubble-based skills. No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have heard a faint whimpering from inside. It must have been their imagination.

items.name: Envoy's Greathorn
items.description: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

items.name: Envoy's Horn
items.description: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

items.name: Envoy's Long Horn
items.description: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

items.name: Erdleaf Flower
items.description: A dusky-yellow flower that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Erdsteel Dagger
items.description: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.  Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield.  Attack power also scales with faith.

items.name: Erdtree Bow
items.description: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

items.name: Erdtree Greatbow
items.description: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

items.name: Erdtree Greatshield
items.description: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.

items.name: Erdtree Heal
items.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.
items.effect: Vastly heals HP for self and nearby allies

items.name: Erdtree's Favor
items.description: A talisman depicting a special blessing of the Erdtree. Slightly raises maximum HP, stamina, and equip load.
items.effect: Raises maximum HP, stamina and equip load

items.name: Erdtree Seal
items.description: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between. Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.

items.name: Erdtree Surcoat
items.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Boots
items.description: Commonplace leather boots, sturdy enough to withstand a long journey.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
items.description: Commonplace leather manchettes. Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe
items.description: Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Errant Sorcerer Robe.

items.name: Estoc
items.description: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

items.name: Eternal Darkness
items.description: Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
items.effect: Creates a dark space that draws in spells

items.name: Exalted Flesh
items.description: A lump of animal pickled in a medicinal solution mixed with fiery spices. Craftable item. Temporarily Boosts physical attack Considered a delicacy in the badlands, this invigorating repast was for the exclusive benefit of those who they called heroes.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts physical attack

items.name: Executioner's Greataxe
items.description: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

items.name: Exile Armor
items.description: Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

items.name: Exile Gauntlets
items.description: Damaged iron gauntlets. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

items.name: Exile Greaves
items.description: Damaged iron greaves. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

items.name: Exile Hood
items.description: Deep red hood that covers the whole head. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were required to keep their faces hidden.

items.name: Explosive Bolt
items.description: Bolt tipped with a shard of Explosive Stone. Explodes on impact, dealing fire damage.

items.name: Explosive Ghostflame
items.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.
items.effect: Causes ghostflame explosion that burns wide area

items.name: Explosive Greatbolt
items.description: Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Explosive Stone shards.

items.name: Explosive Stone
items.description: A small stone with a smoldering core.
items.effect: Explodes when thrown, inflicting Fire Damage

items.name: Explosive Stone Clump
items.description: A clump of small stones with smoldering cores.
items.effect: Explodes when thrown together, inflicting fire damage

items.name: Eye Of Yelough
items.description: A shrub fruit bursting with ripened pulp. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Eye Surcoat
items.description: Brown surcoat draped over chainmail.

items.name: Ezykes's Decay
items.description: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above

items.name: Faded Erdleaf Flower
items.description: An Erdleaf flower that has faded into a plate scarlet, found blooming in rotten lands. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Faith-knot Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts one's faith.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts faith in mixed physick

items.name: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
items.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a group of masked figures. Raises potency of incantations.
items.effect: Raises potency of Incantations

items.name: Falchion
items.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.

items.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
items.description: Part of a Falling star Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.  With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.

items.name: Family Heads
items.description: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage. The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.

items.name: Fan Daggers
items.description: A set of five throwing knives bundled together.
items.effect: Thrown fanned-out knives at enemies to inflict damage

items.name: Fanged Imp Ashes
items.description: Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.
items.effect: Summons two fanged imp spirits

items.name: Fell Omen Cloak
items.description: "A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed body of Margit, the Fell Omen.

items.name: Festering Bloody Finger
items.description: Item for online play.
items.effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world

items.name: Festive Garb
items.description: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Faintly bloodstained.

items.name: Festive Garb (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the  Festive Garb.

items.name: Festive Hood
items.description: Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Decorated with many-colored flowers.

items.name: Festive Hood (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Festive Hood

items.name: Fetid Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside. As the mixture ferments, toxins are produced alongside a putrid stench that seeps out once ripe. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison. Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies. Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to cause deadly buildup of poison.

items.name: Fevor's Cookbook [1]
items.description: Record of crafting techniques left by a man who was denied the path of becoming a Finger Maiden. He instead became a missionary, spreading holy teachings.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Fevor's Cookbook [2]
items.description: Record of crafting techniques left by a man who was denied the path of becoming a Finger Maiden. He instead became a missionary, spreading holy teachings.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Fevor's Cookbook [3]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who was utterly captivated by St. Trina. He continued the search for her in his slumber. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Bewitching Branch
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Fia's Hood
items.description: Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

items.name: Fia's Mist
items.description: Sorcery of Fia, the Deathbed Companion. Creates a deathly mist before the caster, which inflicts Death blight upon those who enter. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances range of the mist. This sorcery was developed to oppose the Roundtable Hold, and is effective only against the Tarnished.
items.effect: Release a mist of death before caster

items.name: Fia's Robe
items.description: Robe of black cloth that covers the entire body. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

items.name: Finger Maiden Fillet
items.description: Fillet worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

items.name: Finger Maiden Robe
items.description: Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

items.name: Finger Maiden Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Finger Maiden Robe.

items.name: Finger Maiden Shoes
items.description: Shoes worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

items.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
items.description: One of Seluvis's puppets.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

items.name: Finger Seal
items.description: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

items.name: Finger Severer
items.description: Item for online play.
items.effect: Sends another, or oneself, home.

items.name: Fingerprint Armor
items.description: Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Fingerprint Armor.

items.name: Fingerprint Gauntlets
items.description: Iron gauntlets singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Grape
items.description: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow.
items.effect: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow

items.name: Fingerprint Greaves
items.description: Iron greaves singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Helm
items.description: Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
items.description: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.

items.name: Fingerslayer Blade
items.description: The hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron; a blade said to have been born of a corpse.
items.effect: Hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron

items.name: Fire Arrow
items.description: Arrow with the tip set alight.Deals fire damage.

items.name: Fire Blossom
items.description: A half-ashen and smoldering flower that blooms on the mountaintops of the Giants. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Fire Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of incendiary materials. Craftable item. Coats armament, adding fire damage to attacks. The effect last only for a short time.
items.effect: Coats weapon, inflicting Fire Damage

items.name: Fire Monk Armor
items.description: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Monk Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fire Monk. Spirit of a stout monk who monitored the Giants' Flame. Versed in fire incantations, and himself steeled against fire. Though he was charged with keeping watch over the Flame, after many years of solemn duty, he has succumbed to its allure.
items.effect: Summons Fire Monk spirit

items.name: Fire Monk Gauntlets
items.description: Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Monk Greaves
items.description: Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Monk Hood
items.description: Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Monks' Prayerbook
items.description: Prayerbook of the Fire Monks, who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants far to the north.
items.effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

items.name: Fire Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of incendiary materials is sealed inside.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to inflict Fire Damage

items.name: Fire Prelate Armor
items.description: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Prelate Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Fire Prelate Armor.

items.name: Fire Prelate Gauntlets
items.description: Black iron gauntlets with the appearance of flames. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Prelate Greaves
items.description: Black iron greaves with the appearance of flames. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire Prelate Helm
items.description: Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a cauldron. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Fire's Deadly Sin
items.description: Incantation originating from a deeply ominous prophecy.
items.effect: Sets area and self ablaze with raging flames

items.name: Fire Scorpion Charm
items.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that burns with fire.
items.effect: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation

items.name: Firebone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is set alight before firing

items.name: Firebone Arrow Fletched
