items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is set alight before firing. Deals fire damage to foes.

items.name: Firebone Bolt
items.description: Bolt carved from animal bone. The tip is set alight before firing. Deals fire damage.

items.name: Fireproof Dried Liver
items.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a flame-hued medical solution. Craftable item. Boosts fire damage negation for a short time, improving damage mitigation against attacks imbued with fire.
items.effect: Boosts  Fire Damage Negation for a short time.

items.name: Flail
items.description: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.  Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.

items.name: Flamberge
items.description: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.  Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.

items.name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
items.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy. The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.

items.name: Flame, Fall Upon Them
items.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
items.effect: Hurls several balls of fire at once

items.name: Flame Fortification
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Increases fire damage negation.

items.name: Flame Of The Fell God
items.description: This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants. Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze. Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.
items.effect: Summons raging fireball that explodes and sets the area ablaze

items.name: Flame, Protect Me
items.description: The most ancient of the Fire Monks' incantations.
items.effect: Greatly increases fire damage negation

items.name: Flame-shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts the power of one's fire attacks.

items.name: Flamedrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman depicting a red ancient dragon. Boosts fire damage negation.
items.effect: Boosts fire damage negation.

items.name: Flaming Bolt
items.description: Bolt with a fiercely burned tip. Deals powerful fire damage.

items.name: Flask Of Cerulean Tears
items.description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.
items.effect: Restores FP

items.name: Flask Of Crimson Tears
items.description: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.
items.effect: Restores HP

items.name: Flask Of Wondrous Physick
items.description: A relic of the physick chemists, priests of the Erdtree. Harnesses the powers of crystal tears, which only form after the passage of many moons. Various specials effects are bestowed upon the drinker, dependent on the specific mixture of crystal tears. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that in the Lands Between, pools of crystal tears amass at the bases of Minor Erdtrees.
items.effect: Bestows various special effects

items.name: Flight Pinion
items.description: Flight feather of a bird of prey. Material used for crafting items. Commonly used for arrow fletchings.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Flock's Canvas Talisman
items.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a mass of masked figures. Greatly raises potency of incantations.
items.effect: Greatly raises potency of Incantations.

items.name: Flowing Curved Sword
items.description: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend. Skill: Spinning Slash Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

items.name: Foot Soldier Cap
items.description: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Gauntlets
items.description: Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Greaves
items.description: Metal Graves that have already been mended countless times. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Helm
items.description: Wholly unembellished iron helm. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Helmet
items.description: Helmet with a protective metal plate. Widely issued to foot soldiers in lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Tabard
items.description: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Forked Greatsword
items.description: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.

items.name: Forked Hatchet
items.description: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

items.name: Formic Rock
items.description: Rock formed from solidified giant ant venom. Highly acidic. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Fortissax's Lightning Spear
items.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Fortissax.
items.effect: Stabs from above with two red lightning spears in tandem

items.name: Founding Rain Of Stars
items.description: The eldest primeval sorcery, said to have been discovered by an
items.effect: Releases a downpour of star rain for a while

items.name: Four-toed Fowl Foot
items.description: Foot of a four-toed fowl. Material used for crafting items. In the Lands Between, having three digits is seen as a bad omen. As such, the rarer four-toed fowl's is a gift of great luck indeed.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Freezing Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of frozen materials.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting frost

items.name: Freezing Mist
items.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.
items.effect: Releases cold mist before caster

items.name: Freezing Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Engraved with the crest of the Carian Royals. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of frost. Originates from the cold, dark moon of Ranni, the Carian princess.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of frost.

items.name: Frenzied Burst
items.description: Incantations originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
items.effect: Emits concentrated blast of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

items.name: Frenzied Cookbook
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by those afflicted by the madness of the flame of frenzy.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Frenzied Flame Seal
items.description: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together.

items.name: Frenzied's Cookbook [1]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by those afflicted by the madness of the flame of frenzy. Contains techniques discovered in desperation.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Frenzyflame Stone
items.description: Ruin fragment blessed with an incantation of the Three Fingers. Craftable item.
items.effect: Uses FP to continuously heal chaos followers

items.name: Frozen Armament
items.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch. Enchants armament held in the right hand with frost. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The snowy crone taught the young Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her cold sorcery.
items.effect: Enchants right-hand armament with frost

items.name: Frozen Lightning Spear
items.description: Incantation that channels the power of the Dragonkin Soldiers. Creates a spear of ice lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning advancing forwards. The Dragonkin were born in the Eternal City, where they knew no true sky, nor true lightning. Instead, ice lightning was their weapon.
items.effect: Stabs with ice lightning spear from above

items.name: Frozen Needle
items.description: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Ijii, the carian Royal Blackmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack.  The blade immediately regenerates.

items.name: Frozen Raisin
items.description: Preparation of dried Rimed Rowa.
items.effect: On horseback, feed to Torrent to vastly restore HP

items.name: Fulgurbloom
items.description: Yellow flower that grows in lightning-struck lands. Material used for crafting items. Imbued with traces of lightning's essence.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Full Moon Crossbow
items.description: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy- infused bolts.

items.name: Fur Leggings
items.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower warriors. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Fur Raiment
items.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
items.description: Item for online play. Craftable item. Reveals cooperative and competitive multiplayer signs. Co-op summoning signs will be shown in gold, while hostile summoning signs will be shown in red. Multiplayer begins when you summon a player from another world through their sign.
items.effect: Reveals co-op and hostile summoning signs

items.name: Furled Finger's Trick-mirror
items.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure. Makes the bearer take on the appearance of a Host of Fingers One of the ritual implements created by the Tarnished to deceive invaders.
items.effect: Take on appearance of a Host of Fingers

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
items.description: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
items.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
items.description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
items.description: Broze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.  Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
items.description: Description  "Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle. Just like the wielder, the missing part have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions."

items.name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
items.description: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

items.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
items.description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

items.name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
items.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

items.name: Gavel Of Haima
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Creates a magical greathammer and slams it down. Allows one follow-up attack. Drawn from the scholarly conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.
items.effect: Attacks using a magic greathammer

items.name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
items.description: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by knights once royal to Praector Rykard.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Gelmir Knight Armor.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Helm
items.description: Helm worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Its crest of red feathers symbolizes Rykard's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son.

items.name: Gelmir's Fury
items.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
items.effect: Covers area with surge of magma from the earth

items.name: Ghiza's Wheel
items.description: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [1]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it. Strengthens renowned ashes to +1. Ashes which keep their renown even after death cannot be strengthened by merely corporal glovewort.
items.effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +1.

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [2]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.
items.effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +2

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [3]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close it.
items.effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +3

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [4]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.
items.effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +4

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [5]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.
items.effect: Strengthen renowned ashes to +5

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [6]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.
items.effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +6

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [7]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs.
items.effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +7

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [8]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs.
items.effect: Stengthened renowed ashes to +8

items.name: Ghost Glovewort [9]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs.  A spirit nestles close to it.
items.effect: Stengthened renowed ashes to +9

items.name: Ghostflame Torch
items.description: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

items.name: Giant-crusher
items.description: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.

items.name: Giant Rat Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats.
items.effect: Summons three giant rat spirits

items.name: Giant's Red Braid
items.description: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

items.name: Giant's Seal
items.description: Sacred seal depicting the one eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.

items.name: Giantsflame Fire Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Giants' Flame. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage. Damage scales with faith.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy fire damage.

items.name: Giantsflame Take Thee
items.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
items.effect: Hurls massive ball of raging fire

items.name: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap
items.description: Flanged cap made from gilded iron. Issued to foot soldiers protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

items.name: Gilded Greatshield
items.description: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

items.name: Gilded Iron Shield
items.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.

items.name: Glaive
items.description: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

items.name: Glass Shard
items.description: Glass shard covered in dirt.
items.effect: Shard of filthy glass. Worthless rubbish

items.name: Glintblade Phalanx
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Forms a defensive arch of magic glintblades

items.name: Glintstone Arc
items.description: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.
items.effect: Fires a horizontally-widening magic arc

items.name: Glintstone Breath
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels dragon to spew icy breath.

items.name: Glintstone Cometshard
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.
items.effect: Fires a magic comet with a trailing tail

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]
items.description: Contains a record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Magic Pot -Roped Magic Pot -Shield Grease
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the academy.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (7)
items.description: A record ofcrafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire.

items.name: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a glintstone craftsman who served the Academy. Contains information on "faux sorceries,"such as they were called. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Academy Magic Pot
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire.

items.name: Glintstone Firefly
items.description: A firefly whose glowing tail has hardened into glintstone, widely found in Liurnia Lake. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Glintstone Icecrag
items.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.
items.effect: Fires mass of cold magic from glintstone

items.name: Glintstone Kris
items.description: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

items.name: Glintstone Pebble
items.description: The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Fires magic projectiles from glintstone

items.name: Glintstone Scarab
items.description: Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

items.name: Glintstone Scrap
items.description: Piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels. Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt. Poor quality and thereby easily broken, a sorcerer wouldn't give it a second look.
items.effect: Break gem, using FP to produce a magic bolt.

items.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer.
items.effect: Summons glintstone sorcerer spirit

items.name: Glintstone Staff
items.description: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

items.name: Glintstone Stars
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Fires three shooting stars that pursue foes

items.name: Glintstone Whetblade
items.description: Glintstone whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.
items.effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

items.name: Glowstone
items.description: Polished Ruin Fragment that shines brighter than a Rainbow Stone. Craftable item. Emits light from the location it is placed, illuminating surroundings. However, the effect is short-lived, and it lacks the diverse colors of rainbow stones. May serve some benefit in dark places, or at night.
items.effect: Emits a faint light from the location it is placed

items.name: Godfrey Icon
items.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Godfrey. Raises charge attack power of sorceries, incantations, and skills.
items.effect: Enhances charged spells and skills.

items.name: Godksin Noble Robe
items.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles known for their seven-face aprons. Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godrick Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick The Grafted.

items.name: Godrick Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Godric Knight Armor.

items.name: Godrick Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Godrick Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Godrick Knight Helm
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Godrick's soldiers.
items.effect: Summons two Godrick soldier spirits

items.name: Godrick Soldier Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Helm
items.description: Helm worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Bracelets
items.description: Black bracelets of the Godskin Apostles.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Hood
items.description: Hood made by seweing together patches of smooth skin. Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Robe
items.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Trousers
items.description: Trousers made by seweing together patches of smooth skin.

items.name: Godskin Noble Bracelets
items.description: Black bracelets of the Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godskin Noble Hood
items.description: Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unilke the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godskin Noble Trousers
items.description: Trousers made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes them plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godskin Peeler
items.description: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

items.name: Godskin Stitcher
items.description: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.

items.name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
items.description: Sacred cloth of the Godskin Apostles, made from supple skin sewn together.
items.effect: Successive attacks restore HP

items.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
items.description: Sacred sword of the Dusk-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

items.name: Godslayer's Seal
items.description: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian. Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.

items.name: Gold Bracelets
items.description: Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made my Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.

items.name: Gold Firefly
items.description: Firefly that gives off a golden light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of water close to Minor Erdtrees. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Golden light is considered to invite runes.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Gold-pickled Fowl Foot
items.description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a golden medicinal solution. Craftable item. Boosts the amount of runes obtained from defeating enemies for a certain duration Since old times, the needy would scrape the meat clean even from a fowl's claw.
items.effect: Boosts rune acquisition for a time (30%)

items.name: Gold Scarab
items.description: A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.
items.effect: Increases runes obtained from

items.name: Gold Sewing Needle
items.description: Sewing needle made of gold.
items.effect: Special sewing needle for demigod attire

items.name: Gold-tinged Excrement
items.description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Often hidden in woods and thickets. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Gold Waistwrap
items.description: Waistwrap made in the image of Erdtree branches. A minimal adornment made by Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.

items.name: Golden Arrow
items.description: Carved arrows made in tandem with the Erdtree Bow. Deals holy damage.

items.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
items.description: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greratshields, and subsequently easier to wield. The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.

items.name: Golden Bolt
items.description: Bolt blessed with an incantation of the Erdtree. Deals powerful holy damage

items.name: Golden Centipede
items.description: The golden, desiccated remains of a centipede.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Golden Dung
items.description: Someone's excrement. It has a golden tinge. Material used for crafting items. Gold-tinged excrement is a highly stable substance; it doesn't dry out, nor does it lose its customary warmth or scent. For better or for worse, it remains as it is.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Golden Epitaph
items.description: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."

items.name: Golden Great Arrow
items.description: Carved greatarrows made together with the Erdtree Greatbow. Deals holy damage.

items.name: Golden Greatshield
items.description: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

items.name: Golden Halberd
items.description: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights.  Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one mere human strength to wield.

items.name: Golden Lightning Fortification
items.description: An incantation of Erdtree Worship.
items.effect: Greatly increases lightning resistance for self and allies

items.name: Golden Order Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.

items.name: Golden Order Seal
items.description: A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Fundamentalist incantations.  Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantation using both intelligence and faith.

items.name: Golden Prosthetic
items.description: Golden prosthetic forged using ancient techniques

items.name: Golden Rowa
items.description: A Rowa fruit tinted with gold. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for craftign items

items.name: Golden Rune [1]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain a small number of runes

items.name: Golden Rune [10]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.
items.effect: Use to gain a great many runes

items.name: Golden Rune (11)
items.effect: Use to gain many runes

items.name: Golden Rune [13]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain a great many runes

items.name: Golden Rune [2]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain a small number of runes (400)

items.name: Golden Rune [3]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Land Between;
items.effect: Use to gain runes

items.name: Golden Rune [4]
items.description: Grace that dwells Within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain runes

items.name: Golden Rune [5]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.
items.effect: Use to gain runes (1600)

items.name: Golden Rune [6]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain many runes

items.name: Golden Rune [7]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.
items.effect: Use to gain many runes

items.name: Golden Rune [8]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.
items.effect: Use to gain many runes

items.name: Golden Rune [9]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering trace of gold.
items.effect: Use to gain many runes

items.name: Golden Seed
items.description: A golden seed, found at the base of an illusory tree.
items.effect: Increases Sacred Flask's number of uses

items.name: Golden Sunflower
items.description: A golden sunflower that grows facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Golden Tailoring Tools
items.description: Tailoring tools made from gold.
items.effect: Allows demigod garb alteration at sites of grace

items.name: Golden Vow (spell)
items.description: An incantation of Erdtree Worship.
items.effect: Increases attack and defense for self and allies

items.name: Goldmask's Rags
items.description: Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excess of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

items.name: Golem Greatbow
items.description: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

items.name: Golem's Great Arrow
items.description: Greatarrow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Used by the Guardian Golem.This hefty arrow is enrobed in tempestuous winds, allowing it to break enemy stances and guards with ease.

items.name: Golem's Halberd
items.description: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

items.name: Grace Mimic
items.description: A fetish indicating the guidance of grace.
items.effect: Light shows the path, but without order

items.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
items.description: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret.  One of the legendary armaments.  A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

items.name: Grafted Dragon
items.description: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

items.name: Grass Hair Ornament
items.description: A headdress made from wildflowers. Wearing this might make you less easy to spot.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits. Strengthens ashes to +1. The art of strengthening ashes is known as spirit tuning. only a spirit tuner may perform this deed.
items.effect: Strengthen ashes to +1.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [2]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits. Strengthens ashes to +2. Spirit tuning is not merely the simple act of imbuing strength. It is an art that lies somewhere between tuning an instrument and conducting a conversation, leaving both parties enriched.
items.effect: Strengthen ashes to +2.

items.name: Grave Glovewort [3]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthen ashes to +3

items.name: Grave Glovewort [4]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +4

items.name: Grave Glovewort [5]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +5

items.name: Grave Glovewort [6]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +6

items.name: Grave Glovewort [7]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +7

items.name: Grave Glovewort [8]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +8

items.name: Grave Glovewort [9]
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +9

items.name: Grave Scythe
items.description: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

items.name: Grave Violet
items.description: A purple flower than blooms in graveyards. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
items.description: Defensive wear encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Gravekeeper Cloak.

items.name: Gravel Stone
items.description: A small clump of sharp, pointed stones. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Graven-mass Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting the first school of graven mages — a nightmare that would continue to haunt the academy.  Greatly raises potency of sorceries.  The primeval current is a forbidden tradition of glintstone sorcery. To those who cleave to its teachings, the act of collecting sorcerers to fashion them into the seeds of stars is but another path of scientific inquiry.
items.effect: Greatly raises potency of sorceries.

items.name: Graven-school Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a school of graven mages, the nightmare of the academy.
items.effect: Raises potency of sorceries

items.name: Gravity Stone Chunk
items.description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike.
items.effect: Uses FP to cause a gravitational explosion

items.name: Gravity Stone Fan
items.description: Shard of rock found in the wake of a meteorite strike.
items.effect: Uses FP to emit fan-shaped gravitational shockwave

items.name: Gravity Well
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Fires a projectile of condensed gravitational force. Those struck by it will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency. A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.
items.effect: Pulls foes toward caster with gravity projectile

items.name: Great Arrow
items.description: A greatarrow as large as a spear for use with greatbows. Used by archers of monstrous strength employed by a lord's army.

items.name: Great Club
items.description: An enormous club of hardwood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.

items.name: Great Dragonfly Head
items.description: Head of a large dragonfly. Material used for crafting items. Long believed to have the ability to neutralize poisons.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Great Épée
items.description: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade.  Commonly used in life or death duels. Like its smaller counterparts, its made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.

items.name: Great Ghost Glovewort
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to this grand specimen.
items.effect: Strengthens renowned ashes to +10

items.name: Great Glintstone Shard
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
items.effect: Fires larger magic projectiles from glintstone

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort
items.description: White flower that blooms in catacombs. An especially large specimen.
items.effect: Strengthens ashes to +10

items.name: Great Heal
items.description: Superior incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Greatly Heals HP for self and nearby allies

items.name: Great Horned Headband
items.description: Headband decorated by a pair of great horns.

items.name: Great-jar's Arsenal
items.description: A charm that resembles a great jar overflowing with weaponry. Vastly boosts maximum equipment load.
items.effect: Vastly Raises maximum equip load (~19%)

items.name: Great Knife
items.description: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

items.name: Great Mace
items.description: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.

items.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
items.description: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omen ktillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.

items.name: Great Oracular Bubble
items.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient
items.effect: Launches a large magic bubble

items.name: Great Stars
items.description: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss. A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.

items.name: Great Turtle Shell
items.description: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.

items.name: Greataxe
items.description: Greatxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.

items.name: Greatblade Phalanx
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Creates a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. Used by the enchanted troll knights. They were the comrades of the young Rennala, bound by oath.
items.effect: Forms a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades

items.name: Greatbow
items.description: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

items.name: Greathelm
items.description: Sturdy greathelm made from iron. Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Greathood
items.description: Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover. A burial shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they sought.

items.name: Greathorn Hammer
items.description: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

items.name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits.
items.effect: Summons five greatshield soldier spirits

items.name: Greatshield Talisman
items.description: Talisman depicting a knight holding a greatshield. Boosts guarding ability.
items.effect: Boosts guarding ability.

items.name: Greatsword
items.description: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.

items.name: Green Turtle Talisman
items.description: A talisman in the shape of a green turtle. Raises stamina recovery speed.
items.effect: Raises stamina recovery speed.

items.name: Greenburst Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction gradually restores stamina recovery speed.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts stamina recovery speed in mixed physick.

items.name: Greenspill Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts stamina in mixed physick

items.name: Greyoll's Roar
items.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Greyoll, the Elder Dragon. An incantation of legendary status.
items.effect: Emits the roar of Elder Dragon Greyoll.

items.name: Grossmesser
items.description: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

items.name: Guardian Bracers
items.description: Engraved golden bracers. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Guardian Garb
items.description: Engraved golden garb. Worn by guardians of the Minor Erdtree.

items.name: Guardian Garb (full Bloom)
items.description: Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees. Raises the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but greatly lowers fire damage negation. It is said that the blood-red flowers blooming on their backs mark the senescence of their ancient pact. Perhaps the guardians are part tree already

items.name: Guardian Greaves
items.description: Engraved golden greaves. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

items.name: Guardian Mask
items.description: Engraved golden mask.

items.name: Guardian's Swordspear
items.description: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

items.name: Guilty Hood
items.description: Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown. The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by the collar of sharpened branches.

items.name: Gurrang's Beast Claw
items.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
items.effect: Creates beast claws to rend surroundings with shockwaves

items.name: Haima Glintstone Crown
items.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

items.name: Halberd
items.description: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

items.name: Haligbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled From animal bones. The tip is daubed with a golden tincture. Deals holy damage. Craftable item.

items.name: Haligbone Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a golden tincture. Deals holy damage. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

items.name: Haligbone Bolt
items.description: Bolt carved from animal bone. The tip is daubed with a golden tincture. Deals holy damage. Craftable item.

items.name: Haligdrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman depicting a golden ancient dragon. Boosts holy damage negation.
items.effect: Boosts holy damage negation.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
items.description: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Surcoat
items.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. The surcoat bears the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

items.name: Haligtree Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Haligtree Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Haligtree Helm
items.description: Helm worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. An iron helm graced by a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by knights sworn the Haligtree.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Haligtree Knight Armor.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
items.description: Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

items.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (left)
items.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.
items.effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Rold

items.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (right)
items.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.
items.effect: Join medallions to operate Grand Lift of Rold

items.name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Haligtree soldiers. Spirits of common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.
items.effect: Summons four Haligtree soldier spirits

items.name: Halo Scythe
items.description: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

items.name: Hammer
items.description: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.  The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

items.name: Hammer Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a hammer and a knight. Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against a blocking opponent.
items.effect: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.description: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

items.name: Hand Ballista
items.description: An unconventional ballistic device modeled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.  Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle on facing an entire army alone.

items.name: Hand Of Malenia
items.description: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

items.name: Harp Bow
items.description: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.

items.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
items.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Adorned with a long-forgotten crest of Stormveil, ancient in design.

items.name: Heal
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Heals HP for you and nearby allies.

items.name: Heater Shield
items.description: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.description: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

items.name: Hefty Beast Bone
items.description: Thick, solid beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting particularly large beasts. Commonly Used to make disposable weapons.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Helphen's Steeple
items.description: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.

items.name: Herba
items.description: Evergreen leaves that give off a faith light. Material used for crafting items. This very common medicinal plant can be found in thickets and elsewhere.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Hero's Rune [1]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain an abundance of runes.

items.name: Hero's Rune [5]
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain an abundance of runes.

items.name: Hidden Plumage
items.description: Rarely-seen dark plumage found inside the wing. Material used for crafting items. Death's bearers were once said to have taken the form of birds, symbolized by these black feathers.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Hierodas Glintstone Crown
items.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence and endurance to the detriment of FP. The crown of Hierodas was granted to scholars who engaged in nomadic study away from the academy.

items.name: High Page Clothes
items.description: Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

items.name: High Page Clothes (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the High Page Clothes.

items.name: High Page Hood
items.description: Hood of a page selected for special privilege by the noble they serve.

items.name: Highland Axe
items.description: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.  Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.

items.name: Highwayman Cloth Armor
items.description: Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

items.name: Highwayman Gauntlets
items.description: Hideously stained and dented gauntlets. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

items.name: Highwayman Hood
items.description: Hideously stained and ragged hood. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

items.name: Holy-shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts holy attacks in mixed physick

items.name: Holy Water Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict holy damage

items.name: Holyproof Dried Liver
items.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a golden medicinal solution. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts holy damage negation

items.name: Honed Bolt
items.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
items.effect: Strikes foe with lightning bolt from above

items.name: Hookclaws
items.description: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.  Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

items.name: Horn Bow
items.description: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers.  Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used magic-infused arrows.

items.name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
items.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

items.name: Hoslow's Armor
items.description: Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family. When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused. "I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

items.name: Hoslow's Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Hoslow's Armor.

items.name: Hoslow's Gauntlets
items.description: Garish silver gauntlets decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

items.name: Hoslow's Greaves
items.description: Garish silver greaves decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

items.name: Hoslow's Helm
items.description: A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments. Symbol of the head of the head of the revered House of Hoslow.

items.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
items.description: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down though the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastation

items.name: Host's Trick-mirror
items.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.
items.effect: Take on appearance of a cooperator

items.name: Hosts' Trick-mirror
items.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.
items.effect: Take on appearance of a cooperator

items.name: Howl Of Shabriri
items.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
items.effect: Shrieks, building up madness in nearby foes

items.name: Human Bone Shard
items.description: Fragment of bone with dun mottling. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting Those Who Live in Death.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Ice Crest Shield
items.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. The ice crest originates from a Carian princess. Thogh the effect is slight, it boosts magic damage negation and resistance to frost.

items.name: Icerind Hatchet
items.description: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.

items.name: Icon Shield
items.description: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipients of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty. The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.

items.name: Iji's Mirrorhelm
items.description: Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass, said to have never left War Counselor Iji's head. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

items.name: Imbued Sword Key
items.description: Stone key shaped like a sword. A special item, imbued with rich blue magic.
items.effect: Unseals sending gate, but disappears upon use

items.name: Immunizing Cured Meat
items.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a green medicinal solution. Craftable item. Temporarily boosts immunity Higher immunity helps to mitigate the buildup of various poisons and scarlet rot
items.effect: Temporarily boosts Immunity

items.name: Immunizing Horn Charm
items.description: An accountrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises immunity. (Immunity governs resistance to poison and rot.)
items.effect: Raises Immunity

items.name: Immunizing White Cured Meat
items.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a green medicinal solution.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts immunity

items.name: Immutable Shield
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
items.effect: Increases left-hand shield's affinity/ailment resistance

items.name: Imp Head (cat)
items.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a cat, it holds trace amounts of feline intelligence.

items.name: Imp Head (corpse)
items.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling the visage of a corpse, it holds trace amounts of lingering faith.

items.name: Imp Head (elder)
items.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling an elder, it holds trace amounts of arcane knowledge.

items.name: Imp Head (fanged)
items.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a fanged demon, it holds trace amounts of bestial strength.

items.name: Imp Head (long-tongued)
items.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

items.name: Imp Head (wolf)
items.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a wolf, it holds trace amounts of lupine endurance.

items.name: Incantation Scarab
items.description: Golden scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors. Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken. As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for long journey to its home nest.

items.name: Inescapable Frenzy
items.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
items.effect: Latches onto foes to spread madness

items.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
items.description: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the  Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conveived by a thorough mind.

items.name: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts intelligence in mixed physick.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
items.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
items.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Invigorating Cured Meat
items.description: Cured strip of meat, dried out after pickling in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts Robustness

items.name: Invigorating White Cured Meat
items.description: A white sliced meat, dried out after pickling in a red medicinal solution. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts Robustness

items.name: Irina's Letter
items.description: Letter given by Irina, addressed to her father, the commander of Castle Morne. Gorgeous silken handkerchief, lightly stained with blood. Words can be made out within
items.effect: Letter addressed to the commander of Castle Morne

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

items.name: Iron Cleaver
items.description: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.  Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

items.name: Iron Gauntlets
items.description: Ordinary iron gauntlets.

items.name: Iron Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

items.name: Iron Helmet
items.description: An iron helmet showing rust on its edges. Cloth covering the mouth and neck provides some resistance to poison and other irritants.

items.name: Iron Kasa
items.description: Iron kasa of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Crafted to imitate the woven straw hats worn in the Land of Reeds.

items.name: Iron Roundshield
items.description: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

items.name: Iron Spear
items.description: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

items.name: Iron Whetblade
items.description: Iron whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.
items.effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon

items.name: Ivory-draped Tabard
items.description: Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

items.name: Ivory Sickle
items.description: Sickle fashioned form ivory.  Weapon carried by aged Albunaurics. These weapons re evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

items.name: Jar
items.description: Jar that fits cleanly over the head when upturned. Made with pride by Iron Fist Alexander. In a uniquely jarlike gesture of friendship, it boosts the power of throwing pot items.

items.name: Jar Cannon
items.description: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.  Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.

items.name: Jarwight Puppet
items.description: One of Seluvis' puppets. Use to summon the spirit of a jarwight.
items.effect: Summons Jarwight spirit

items.name: Jawbone Axe
items.description: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

items.name: Jellyfish Shield
items.description: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield. The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supple, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
items.description: Cap worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
items.description: Robe worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

items.name: Kaiden Armor
items.description: Armor worn by Kaiden sellswords.

items.name: Kaiden Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Kaiden sellswords.

items.name: Kaiden Helm
items.description: Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords. These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

items.name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword.
items.effect: Summons Kaiden Sellsword spirit.

items.name: Kaiden Trousers
items.description: Trousers worn by Kaiden sellswords.

items.name: Katar
items.description: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.

items.name: Kindred Of Rot Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot. This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.
items.effect: Summons Kindred of Rot spirit

items.name: Kindred Of Rot's Exultation
items.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of pests.
items.effect: Poisoning or rot in vicinity increases attack power

items.name: Kite Shield
items.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

items.name: Knight Armor
items.description: Iron armor of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Iron gauntlets of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight Greaves
items.description: Iron greaves of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight Helm
items.description: Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight's Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

items.name: Kukri
items.description: A large knife used for throwing.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up onset of blood loss

items.name: Lance
items.description: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.

items.name: Lance Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a lance and a knight. Enhances attacks while on horseback.
items.effect: Enhances attacks on horseback

items.name: Land Octopus Ovary
items.description: Puffy, milky white ovary of a land octopus. Material used for crafting items. Land octopuses eat humans in order to bear young, and theirs is the blood that runs through these ovaries.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Land Of Reeds Armor
items.description: Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

items.name: Land Of Reeds Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets wrapped in tough leather. Worn by the warriors of the Land of Reeds

items.name: Land Of Reeds Greaves
items.description: Greaves wrapped in tough leather.

items.name: Land Of Reeds Helm
items.description: Helm made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

items.name: Land Squirt Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings
items.effect: Summons three land squirts

items.name: Lands Between Rune
items.description: Grace said to have once dwelled in the eyes of the inhabitants of the Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold.
items.effect: Use to gain many runes

items.name: Lansseax's Glaive
items.description: Incantation that channels the powr of the ancient dragon Lansseax.
items.effect: Sweeps from above with red lightning glaive.

items.name: Lantern
items.description: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.
items.effect: Attach to waist to illuminate surroundings

items.name: Large Club
items.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.

items.name: Large Glintstone Scrap
items.description: Large piece of glintstone tinged with unstable magic. Found in crystal tunnels.
items.effect: Break gem and use FP to produce many magic bolts

items.name: Large Leather Shield
items.description: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.

items.name: Larval Tear
items.description: Core of a creature of mimicry known as a silver tear.
items.effect: Material needed by Rennala to grant rebirth

items.name: Latenna The Albinauric
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric.
