items.effect: Summons the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric

items.name: Law Of Causality
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
items.effect: Retaliates upon receiving a number of blows

items.name: Law Of Regression
items.description: Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.
items.effect: Heals all ailments and dispels all special effects

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
items.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
items.description: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

items.name: Lazuli Robe
items.description: Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy. These scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

items.name: Leaden Hardtear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts poise in mixed physick

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier.

items.name: Leather Boots
items.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather boots worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

items.name: Leather-draped Tabard
items.description: Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl draped over the shoulders.

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather gloves worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

items.name: Leather Trousers
items.description: Well-made leather trousers. The lower legs are each bound in cord for ease of movement.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Leyndell Knight Armor.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster

items.name: Leyndell Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Helm
items.description: Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers. Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.
items.effect: Summons two Leyndell soldier spirits

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Helm
items.description: Helm worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

items.name: Lhutel The Headless
items.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.description: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

items.name: Lightning Fortification
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Increass lighting damage negation

items.name: Lightning Greabolt
items.description: Greatbolt tipped with a climp of Gravel Stone shards.

items.name: Lightning Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of fulminating materials. Craftable item.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting lightning damage

items.name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
items.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that sparks with lightning.
items.effect: Raises lightning attack, but lowers damage negation

items.name: Lightning-shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts lightning attacks in mixed physick

items.name: Lightning Spear
items.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point ofimpact. Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.
items.effect: Hurls lightning spear before caster

items.name: Lightning Strike
items.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
items.effect: Summons lightning bolt that spreads from impact.

items.name: Lightningbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones with a lightning-infused tip. Deals lightning damage.Craftable item.

items.name: Lightningbone Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones with a lightning-infused tip. Deals lightning damage.Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

items.name: Lightningbone Bolt
items.description: Bolt crafted from animal bone with a lightning-infused tip. Deals lightning damage. Craftable item.

items.name: Lightningproof Dried Liver
items.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in an yellow medicinal
items.effect: Temporarily boosts lightning damage negation

items.name: Lion Greatbow
items.description: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

items.name: Lionel's Armor
items.description: Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back. Worn by the Lionel the Lionhearted.

items.name: Lionel's Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Lionel's Armor.

items.name: Lionel's Gauntlets
items.description: Founded iron gauntlets.

items.name: Lionel's Greaves
items.description: Rounded iron greaves. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

items.name: Lionel's Helm
items.description: Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

items.name: Litany Of Proper Death
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
items.effect: Creates image of Order to deal holy damage

items.name: Living Jar Shard
items.description: A fragment of a living jar, hardened after its death. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Lone Wolf Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves.
items.effect: Summons three lone wolf spirits.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

items.name: Longhaft Axe
items.description: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

items.name: Longsword
items.description: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.

items.name: Longtail Cat Talisman
items.description: A brooch depicting Lacrima, the long-tailed cat.
items.effect: Renders the wearer immune to fall damage

items.name: Lord Of Blood's Exultation
items.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood.
items.effect: Enhances critical hits

items.name: Lord Of Blood's Robe
items.description: Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth. The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

items.name: Lord Of Blood's Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Lord Of Blood's Robe.

items.name: Lord's Aid
items.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished
items.effect: Alleviates poison / blood loss / sleep buildup for self / allies

items.name: Lord's Divine Fortification
items.description: Incantation taught to Gideon the All-Knowing by the Two
items.effect: Greatly increases holy damage negation incl. allies

items.name: Lord's Heal
items.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished
items.effect: Massively heals HP for self and nearby allies

items.name: Lord's Rune
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of the Lands Between;
items.effect: Use to gain an enormous abundance of runes

items.name: Lordsworn's Bolt
items.description: Well-crafted bolt with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.

items.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
items.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Through blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

items.name: Lordsworn's Shield
items.description: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
items.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a servicable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

items.name: Loretta's Greatbow
items.description: Sorcery used by Royal Knight Loretta. Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked. It is said that the bow was Loretta's favored weapon.
items.effect: Fires great arrow from a magic greatbow

items.name: Loretta's Mastery
items.description: Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked. Developed by Loretta after her long, bloody journey to seek out a place where the Albinaurics could live in peace.
items.effect: Fires four great arrow from a magic greatbow at once

items.name: Loretta's War Sickle
items.description: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

items.name: Lost Ashes Of War
items.description: Empty ashes of war, devoid of any memories of battle.Unable to apply any kind of affinity in their current state, but can be used by Smithing Master Hewg of the Roundtable Hold to recreate other ashes.Thus does the copy pass into becoming the genuine article.

items.name: Lucerne
items.description: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.

items.name: Lucidity
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep and madness

items.name: Lump Of Flesh
items.description: A lump of beast flesh filled with rich juices. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting carnivorous beast. Meat suitable for a rustic feast.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Crown
items.description: The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
items.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom ofstone may wield it. Enhances power ofall sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

items.name: Lusat's Manchettes
items.description: Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones. Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

items.name: Lusat's Robe
items.description: A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue glintstones.

items.name: Mace
items.description: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.

items.name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.
items.effect: Summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head

items.name: Magic Downpour
items.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.
items.effect: Summon a magic mass that sprays projectiles over area

items.name: Magic Fortification
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me – the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
items.effect: Increases magic damage negation

items.name: Magic Glintblade
items.description: An old sorcery of the Carian Royal Family.
items.effect: Creates sigil that forms a projectile glintblade after delay

items.name: Magic Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting magic damage

items.name: Magic Scorpion Charm
items.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.
items.effect: Raises magic attack, but lowers damage negation

items.name: Magic-shrouding Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts magic attacks in mixed physick

items.name: Magicbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a glintstone tincture. Deals magic damage. Craftable item.

items.name: Magicbone Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a glintstone tincture. Deals magic damage.Craftable item. The Retching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

items.name: Magicbone Bolt
items.description: Bolt carved from animal bone. The tip is daubed with a glintstone tincture. Deals magic damage. Craftable item.

items.name: Magma Blade
items.description: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

items.name: Magma Breath
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels wyrm to spew magma breath

items.name: Magma Shot
items.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
items.effect: Fire lump of magma that explodes on contact

items.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
items.description: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

items.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
items.description: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once humans heroes who partook in dragon communication, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

items.name: Malenia's Armor
items.description: Armor made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Maleinia's Armor.

items.name: Malenia's Gauntlet
items.description: Gauntlet made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Greaves
items.description: Greaves made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Winged Helm
items.description: Winged helm made of unalloyed gold.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
items.description: Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets
items.description: Malformed golden gauntlets.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Greaves
items.description: Malformed golden greaves.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Helm
items.description: A malformed golden helm. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

items.name: Maliketh's Armor
items.description: Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

items.name: Maliketh's Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Maliketh's Armor.

items.name: Maliketh's Black Blade
items.description: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

items.name: Maliketh's Gauntlets
items.description: Beast's gauntlets made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyral half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions

items.name: Maliketh's Greaves
items.description: Beast's greaves made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

items.name: Maliketh's Helm
items.description: Beast's helm made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

items.name: Man-serpent Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.
items.effect: Summons man-serpent spirit

items.name: Man-serpent's Shield
items.description: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

items.name: Manor Towershield
items.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Mantis Blade
items.description: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.  The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.

items.name: Map (ainsel River)
items.description: Map of Ainsel River and environs
items.effect: Map of Ainsel River and environs

items.name: Map (altus Plateau)
items.description: Map of Altus Plateau and environs. The Altus Plateau, where the Erdtree's base can be found, contains the Royal Capital of Leyndell to the east, and Mt. Gelmir to the west. Scars from the Shattering remain apparent to this day.
items.effect: Reveals  Altus Plateau on your map

items.name: Map (caelid)
items.description: Map of Caelid and environs.
items.effect: Reveals the region of Caelid on the map.

items.name: Map (consecrated Snowfield)
items.description: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs. The route through this land, crossed east to west by a frozen river, leads to Miquella's Haligtree. This is the path taken by those unchosen, though it is a trial all the same.
items.effect: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs.

items.name: Map (deeproot Depths)
items.description: Map of Deeproot Depths and environs. At the very depths of the Erdtree's majestic roots lies the source of the Ainsel and the Siofra rivers. Here too begins the network of Greattree roots that spread throughout the Lands Between.
items.effect: Revels Deeproot Depths and environs on your map

items.name: Map (dragonbarrow)
items.description: Map of Dragonbarrow and environs.
items.effect: Reveals the region of Dragonbarrow on the map.

items.name: Map (lake Of Rot)
items.description: Map of Lake of Rot and environs. A great lake of standing water downstream of the Ainsel River. It is said that the divine essence of an outer god is sealed away in this land.
items.effect: Map of Lake of Rot and environs.

items.name: Map (leyndell, Royal Capital)
items.description: Map of the Royal Capital of Leyndell and environs.
items.effect: Reveals the region of Leyndell on the map.

items.name: Map (limgrave, East)
items.description: Map of the eastern region of Limgrave.
items.effect: Map of Limgrave's eastern region

items.name: Map (limgrave, West)
items.description: Map of the western region of Limgrave. The demesne of Limgrave, far south of the Erdtree, is bordered to the northwest by the cliffs of Stormveil, and under its ever-clouded skies roll the great steppes of the pale lands.
items.effect: Map of Limgrave's western region.

items.name: Map (liurnia, East)
items.description: Map of Liurnia's eastern region.
items.effect: Map of Liurnia's eastern region

items.name: Map (liurnia, North)
items.description: Map of Liurnia's northern region.
items.effect: Map of Liurnia's northern region

items.name: Map (liurnia, West)
items.description: Map of Liurnia's western region.
items.effect: Reveals the western portion of Liurnia on your map.

items.name: Map (mountaintops Of The Giants, East)
items.description: Map of Eastern Mountaintops of the Giants. The remote, desolate eastern summit is the highest point in all the Lands Between, overlooking even the Flame Peak to the south.
items.effect: Map of Eastern Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Map (mountaintops Of The Giants, West)
items.description: Map of Western Mountaintops of the Giants. Marching ground during the War against the Giants. They carved winding paths in the cliff walls right up to the summit, leading to the untrodden snow-laden region beyond.
items.effect: Map of Western Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Map (mt. Gelmir)
items.effect: Map of Mt. Gelmir region

items.name: Map (siofra River)
items.description: Map of Siofra River and environs
items.effect: Reveals the region of Siofra River on the map.

items.name: Map (weeping Peninsula)
items.description: Map of the Weeping Peninsula.
items.effect: Map of Weeping peninsula

items.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
items.description: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid..

items.name: Marais Mask
items.description: Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. Increases arcane. The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

items.name: Marais Robe
items.description: Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce goddess who was born into rot.

items.name: Margit's Shackle
items.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time.
items.effect: Binds Margit and Morgott two times per battle

items.name: Marika's Hammer
items.description: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

items.name: Marika's Scarseal
items.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of Queen Marika.
items.effect: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

items.name: Marika's Soreseal
items.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of Queen Marika.
items.effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Armor
items.description: Armor of metal bands arranged in a lattice. Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers. The construction of this armor is remarkably crude, now rusted over and severely dented. For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two marionette soldiers.
items.effect: Summons two marionette soldier spirits

items.name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm
items.description: Metal helm formed in the likeness of the face of a bird.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Helm
items.description: Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice. Worm by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

items.name: Marred Leather Shield
items.description: Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Miuch like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

items.name: Marred Wooden Shield
items.description: "Wooden shield of the Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle."

items.name: Mask Of Confidence
items.description: Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread. Increases arcane. When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their matters were to be kept strictly private.

items.name: Mausoleum Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Mausoleum Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Museum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. The wing-shaped ornaments on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve theirs masters in death.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Mausoleum Knight Armor

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Walking Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five mausoleum soldiers. Spirits of five headless soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will. The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.
items.effect: Summons five mausoleum soldier spirits

items.name: Mausoleum Surcoat
items.description: Armor worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

items.name: Melted Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom that grows in the false night in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Memory Of Grace
items.description: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.
items.effect: Lose all runes, return to last site of lost grace.

items.name: Memory Stone
items.description: A black, lightly beguiling stone.
items.effect: Increases memory slots

items.name: Meteor Bolt
items.description: Enchanted work of craft made in tandem with Full Moon Crossbow. The tip is embedded with glintstone.

items.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
items.description: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage. The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

items.name: Meteorite
items.description: A glintstone sorcery that draws on gravitational force, used by a great white king with stone skin. Calls small meteorites down from the sky. The meteor shower continues for as long as the sorcery is in effect. It is said that, in the Eternal City, now lost in ruin underground, meteorites held the same import as stars.
items.effect: Calls small meteors down from the sky.

items.name: Meteorite Of Astel
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Summons a void that emits a hail of meteorites. Hold to continue the effect. A manifestation of the power with which Astel leveled the Eternal City.
items.effect: Calls a hail of small meteorites from the void.

items.name: Meteorite Staff
items.description: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well. However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

items.name: Millicent's Gloves
items.description: Gloves worn by Millicent the Rotting

items.name: Millicent's Prosthesis
items.description: Part of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent. The hand is locked into a fist that once raised a sword aloft.
items.effect: Boosts dexterity, raises attack power with successive attacks

items.name: Mimic's Veil
items.description: Golden veil of intricate design.
items.effect: Uses FP to mimic nearby objects.

items.name: Mimic Tear Ashes
items.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.
items.effect: Summons mimic tear spirit

items.name: Miniature Ranni
items.description: A doll resembling Ranni the Witch.
items.effect: Doll resembling Ranni the Witch

items.name: Miquella's Lily
items.description: A delicate water lily of unalloyed gold that has started to fade and wilt. Material used for crafting items. Exeedingly rare to find.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
items.description: Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight — an ill-starred sword with no master. Skill: Sacred Blade

items.name: Mirage Riddle
items.description: A riddle concerning a rise that vanishes like a mirage.
items.effect: Simple map taken from an imp statue.

items.name: Miranda Powder
items.description: Pollen from a man-eating miranda flower. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire—do take care of the little darlings
items.effect: Summons five miranda sprouts

items.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
items.description: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

items.name: Miséricorde
items.description: Dagger favored by military physicians in white.  The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.  Medicine is mercy. and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothes as men of compassion

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [1]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [3]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [4]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Holy Grease -Drawstring Holy Grease -Haligbone Arrow -Haligbone Arrow (Fletched) -Haligbone Bolt
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [5]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Missionary's Cookbook [7]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a man who, unable to become a Finger Maiden, instead became a missionary, and went forth to spread holy teachings. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: -Rejuvenating Boluces
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Mohg's Shackle
items.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic.
items.effect: Briefly binds Mogh, once imprisoned, to earth

items.name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
items.description: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

items.name: Monk's Flameblade
items.description: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

items.name: Monk's Flamemace
items.description: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

items.name: Moon Egg
items.description: Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items. Prized as a symbol of the most sublime slumber.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Moon Of Nokstella
items.description: This legendary talisman is a treasure of Nokstella, the Eternal City.
items.effect: Increases memory slots by 2

items.name: Moonveil
items.description: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian wordsmith.  Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

items.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
items.description: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

items.name: Morning Star
items.description: Warhammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star covered. in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its grace name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

items.name: Mottled Necklace
items.description: A vividly-colored accoutrement precious to the ancestral followers.
items.effect: Raises Robustness, Immunity, and Focus

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: A fungal growth that thrives in damp thickets and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items. Its thick, spongy flesh makes it a key component in throwing pots.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Mushroom Arms
items.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the arms.

items.name: Mushroom Body
items.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the torso. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

items.name: Mushroom Crown
items.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece. Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot. Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

items.name: Mushroom Head
items.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the head.

items.name: Mushroom Legs
items.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the Legs.  To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

items.name: Nagakiba
items.description: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing lenth can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

items.name: Nascent Butterfly
items.description: An arcane butterfly with translucent wings. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Navy Hood
items.description: A hooded cloak of deep navy. Worn by expatriated royalty. Increases mind. Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on missions to faraway lands, from which they would never return. But what choice did they have, having seen the guidance of grace?

items.name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
items.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux. Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Nepheli Loux

items.name: Neutralizing Boluses
items.description: Green boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates poison buildup and cures poison ailment. Poison accumulates gradually, coming into effect once the threshold is reached. Poison ailment lowers HP in steady increments for a period.
items.effect: Alleviates poison buildup and cures poison

items.name: Night Comet
items.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
items.effect: Fires semi-invisible magic comet

items.name: Night Maiden Armor
items.description: Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Night Maiden's Mist
items.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
items.effect: Releases life-sapping silver mist before caster

items.name: Night Maiden Twin Crown
items.description: Twin crowns worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and hides the eyes with silk. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Armor
items.description: Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Night's Cavalry Armor

items.name: Night's Cavalry Gauntlets
items.description: Pitch-black gauntlets thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Greaves
items.description: Pitch-black greaves thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Helm
items.description: Pitch-black helm with flowing black hair. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Helm (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Night's Cavalry Helm.

items.name: Night Shard
items.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
items.effect: Swiftly fires a semi-invisible

items.name: Nightmaiden & Swordtress Puppets
items.description: An old puppet crafted in the Eternal City.
items.effect: Summons nightmaiden & swordstress spirits

items.name: Nightrider Flail
items.description: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads.   Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

items.name: Nightrider Glaive
items.description: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Vavalry who ride funeral seeds.  This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horse back.

items.name: Noble Presence
items.description: Ancient power of the Godskin Nobles.
items.effect: Thrust out belly with gusto to unelash repelling shockwave

items.name: Noble's Estoc
items.description: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.  Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

items.name: Noble's Gloves
items.description: Gloves of plush leather. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

items.name: Noble's Slender Sword
items.description: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

items.name: Noble's Traveling Garb
items.description: Traveling attire fashioned from metallic white silk thread. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

items.name: Noble's Trousers
items.description: White trousers of superior craftsmanship. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

items.name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a noble sorcerer. Spirit of a nobleman who once asked to be given a place at Raya Lucaria to learn glintstone sorceries. His talents were insufficient to be worthy of donning the stone crown, however, and he is only capable ofusing the most rudimentary sorcery.
items.effect: Summons noble sorcerer spirit.

items.name: Nomad Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a nomad.
items.effect: Summons nomad spirit

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Chapeau
items.description: Chapeau of the nomadic merchants.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery
items.description: Finery of the nomadic merchants.

items.description: Lighter version of the Nomadic Merchant's Finery

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Trousers
items.description: Trousers of the nomadic merchants. These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground. Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

items.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
items.description: Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City. Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

items.name: Nox Flowing Sword
items.description: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle. Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened

items.name: Nox Mirrorhelm
items.description: Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass. One among the Eternal City's ritual implements. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks. Worn by those committed to high treason, it wards off the intervention of the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers.

items.name: Nox Monk Armor
items.description: Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Monk Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Nox Monk Armor.

items.name: Nox Monk Bracelets
items.description: Bracelets worn by the monks of the Eternal City. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Monk Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by the monks of the Eternal City. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Monk Hood
items.description: Silk hood worn by the monks of the Eternal City. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Monk Hood (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Nox Monk Hood.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Armor
items.description: Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and wear silk capes. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Nox Swordstress Armor.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Crown
items.description: Crown worn by the swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and the silk hides their eyes. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Crown (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Nox Swordstress Crown.

items.name: Numen'srune
items.description: (insert later)
items.effect: Use to gain a multitude of runes

items.name: O, Flame!
items.description: Incantation of the Fire Monks.
items.effect: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from hand

items.name: Octopus Head
items.description: A land octopus whelp worn directly on the head. Has a lingering warmth reminiscent of human skin. Those who can withstand the smell will find its organic elasticity excellent for negating strikes.

items.name: Official's Attire
items.description: Grubby blue robe worn by magisterial officials to carry out their grim tasks. Surveillance, executions, gruesome rituals... The darkest duties drive the wheels of mankind.

items.name: Oil Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of oil-infused materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to soak them in oil, making them heavily susceptible to fire damage.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to soak them in oil.

items.name: Okina Mask
items.description: A wooden mask that depicts an old man bearing his teeth. The source of the sobriquet of the great swordman of the Land of Reeds. Raises dexterity as it lowers focus.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Cowl
items.description: Cowl made of soft cloth. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Gown
items.description: Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Shoes
items.description: Hard-wearing shoes made of leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

items.name: Old Fang
items.description: A rarely-seen specimen of beast fang.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Old Lord's Talisman
items.description: A legendary talisman depicting the ancient king whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time.
items.effect: Extends spell effect duration

items.name: Old Sorcerer Legwraps
items.description: Ragged waistcloth that extends to the thighs. Common amongst old-fashioned sorcerers.

items.name: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
items.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP. The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

items.name: Omen Armor
items.description: Malformed armor resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

items.name: Omen Bairn
items.description: Doll of a curseborn bairn.
items.effect: Uses FP to unleash wraiths that chase down foes

items.name: Omen Cleaver
items.description: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.  The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorating malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

items.name: Omen Gauntlets
items.description: Malformed Gauntlets resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

items.name: Omen Greaves
items.description: Malformed greaves resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

items.name: Omen Helm
items.description: Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

items.name: Omenkiller Boots
items.description: Long, stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

items.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
items.description: Long,stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

items.name: Omenkiller Robe
items.description: Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience.

items.name: Omenkiller Rollo
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Omenkiller Rollo.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Omenkiller Rollo

items.name: Omensmirk Mask
items.description: Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers. Increases strength. Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight. This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.

items.name: One-eyed Shield
items.description: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth. Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.

items.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore.  The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

items.name: Opaline Bubbletear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Significantly negates damage in mixed physick

items.name: Opaline Hardtear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily boosts all forms of damage negation.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts all damage negations in physick

items.name: Oracle Bubble
items.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient dynasty.
items.effect: Launches several bubbles of magic.

items.name: Oracle Bubbles
items.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient
items.effect: Launches several small magic bubbles.

items.name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
items.description: Ashen Remains in which spirits yet dwell.
items.effect: Summons four Oracle Envoy spirits

items.name: Order Healing
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
items.effect: Alleviates death blight buildup

items.name: Order's Blade
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death. Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived. The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason - all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
items.effect: Enchanted right-hand armament with holy damage

items.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be close in nature to life itself.

items.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
items.description: Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

items.name: Page Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a page.
items.effect: Summons page spirit

items.name: Page Garb
items.description: Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

items.name: Page Garb (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Page Garb.

items.name: Page Hood
items.description: Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

items.name: Page Trousers
items.description: Trousers worn by pages who serve nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

items.name: Parrying Dagger
items.description: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

items.name: Partisan
items.description: Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swing to sweep through foes.

items.name: Pauper's Rune
items.description: Grace that dwells within the inhabitants of The Lands Between; the lingering residue of gold. Use to gain a few runes. For all that they may be feeble things, these runes will act as nourishment for the development of any Tarnished. Provided a Finger Maiden can be found...
items.effect: Use to gain a few runes

items.name: Pearldrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon. Boosts non-physical damage negation.
items.effect: Boosts non-physical damage negation.

items.name: Perfume Bottle
items.description: Glass bottles used by perfumers. Used to seal various scent compounds.
items.effect: Container required for crafting perfume items

items.name: Perfumer Gloves
items.description: Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

items.name: Perfumer Hood
items.description: Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

items.name: Perfumer Robe
items.description: Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

items.name: Perfumer Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Perfurmer's Robe.

items.name: Perfumer's Bolt
items.description: Bolt created with perfumer techniques. Used by nobles' guards and the like.

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [1]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a military perfumer. Contains martial techniques beyond the repertoire of an ordinary physician.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [3]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Perfumer's Cookbook [4]
items.description: A record of crafting techniques left by a depraved perfumer. Contains perilous techniques no ordinary physician would attempt.
items.effect: Expands crafting repertoire

items.name: Perfumer's Shield
items.description: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

items.name: Perfumer's Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a set of perfume bottles. Raises potency of perfume items.
items.effect: Raises potency of perfume items

items.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
items.description: Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

items.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Perfumer's Traveling Garb.

items.name: Perfumer Sarong
items.description: Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

items.name: Perfumer Tricia
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Tricia, the perfumer.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Perfumer Tricia

items.name: Pest's Glaive
items.description: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

items.name: Pest Threads
items.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.
items.effect: Launches countless sticky threads before caster

items.name: Pickaxe
items.description: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

items.name: Pickled Turtle Neck
items.description: Turtle neck meat, pickled in a bitter medicinal solution.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts Stamina recovery

items.name: Pike
items.description: A longspear featuring an especially length handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incrdibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.

items.name: Pillory Shield
items.description: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such. Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.

items.name: Placidusax's Ruin
items.description: Power gleaned form the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.
items.effect: Spews golden breath of Dragonlord Placidusax

items.name: Poison Armament
items.description: Incantation of the servants of rot. Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.

items.name: Poison Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of poison-green materials.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting poison

items.name: Poison Mist
items.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.
items.effect: Releases poison mist before caster.

items.name: Poison Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of poisonous materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison.

items.name: Poison Spraymist
items.description: Forbidden art of depraved perfumers. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to release a poison mist from user's mouth, causing a buildup of poison. Perfumed powder is held in the mouth to dissolve before being expelled. It was once a restorative art, or so it is said.
items.effect: Uses FP to release poison mist from the mouth.

items.name: Poisonbloom
items.description: Flower that grows in toxic terrain. Material used for crafting items. Poisonous, but may also provide the cure.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Poisonbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with venom. Afflicts targets with poison. Craftable item.

items.name: Poisonbone Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with venom. Afflicts targets with poison. Craftable item. The addition of fletching enables more precise shots that can travel farther.

items.name: Poisonbone Bolt
items.description: Bolt carved from animal bone. The tip is daubed with venom. Afflicts targets with poison. Craftable item.

items.name: Poisonbone Dart
items.description: Animal bone sharpened into a knife for throwing, with a poison-laced tip. Craftable item.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage and build up poison

items.name: Poisoned Stone
items.description: A small stone with a poisoned core.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of poison

items.name: Poisoned Stone Clump
items.description: A clump of small stones with poison cores.
items.effect: Throw together to cause buildup of poison

items.name: Prattling Pate "apologies"
items.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Apologies."
items.effect: Emits a voice that says "Apologies"

items.name: Prattling Pate "hello"
items.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.
items.effect: Emits a voice that says "Hello"

items.name: Prattling Pate "please Help"
items.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Please help."
items.effect: Emits a voice that says "Please help"

items.name: Prattling Pate "thank You"
items.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.
items.effect: Emits a voice that says "Thank you"

items.name: Prattling Pate "wonderful"
items.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Wonderful."
items.effect: Emits a voice that says "Wonderful"

items.name: Prattling Pate "you're Beautiful"
items.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a demi-human head. Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful."
items.effect: Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful"

items.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
items.description: Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

items.name: Preceptor's Gloves
items.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

items.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
items.description: A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

items.name: Preceptor's Long Gown (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Preceptor's Long Gown.

items.name: Preceptor's Trousers
items.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

items.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
items.description: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.  The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks' will fling foes into the air.

items.name: Preserving Boluses
items.description: Scarlet boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item.
items.effect: Alleviates scarlet rot buildup and cures rot

items.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
items.description: An old glintstone blade that has been stained with blood.
items.effect: Spells consume less FP, but maximum HP is reduced

items.name: Prince Of Death's Cyst
items.description: A fetid, overgrown cyst taken from facial flesh. Greatly raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)
items.effect: Greatly raises vitality

items.name: Prince Of Death's Pustule
items.description: A fetid pustule taken from facial flesh. Raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)
items.effect: Raises Vitality

items.name: Prince Of Death's Star
items.description: Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries. One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

items.name: Prisoner Clothing
items.description: Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.

items.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
items.description: Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling. A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

items.name: Prisoner Trousers
items.description: Tattered trousers. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy. The smell is beyond belief.

items.name: Prophet Blindfold
items.description: Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

items.name: Prophet Robe
items.description: Robe of exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

items.name: Prophet Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Prophet Robe.

items.name: Prophet Trousers
items.description: Trousers of the exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

items.name: Protection Of The Erdtree
items.description: A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship. Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation. In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
items.effect: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies

items.name: Pulley Bow
items.description: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order Fundamentalism.  Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.

items.name: Pulley Crossbow
items.description: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.   One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

items.name: Pumpkin Helm
items.description: An oval helmet large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard. Reduces damage from headshots and impacts. The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

items.name: Purifying Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the age where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wonderous Physick. The resulting conction purifies the curse from Mohg, Lord of Blood's terrifying rite of blood.
items.effect: Purifies the Lord of Blood's curse in a mixed physick

items.name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses.
items.effect: Summons four putrid corpse spirits

items.name: Queen's Bracelets
items.description: Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
items.description: A tall crown depicting the moon. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Queen's Leggings
items.description: Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Queen's Robe
items.description: Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Radagon Icon
items.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Radagon. Shortens the casting time of sorceries and incantations.
items.effect: Shortens spell casting time

items.name: Radagon's Rings Of Light
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
items.effect: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area

items.name: Radagon's Scarseal
items.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
items.effect: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

items.name: Radagon's Soreseal
items.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
items.effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

items.name: Radahn's Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

items.name: Radahn's Greaves
items.description: Greaves depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

items.name: Radahn's Lion Armor
items.description: Armor depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

items.name: Radahn's Lion Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Radahn's Lion Armor.

items.name: Radahn's Redmane Helm
items.description: Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair. Worn by General Radahn.

items.name: Radahn's Spear
items.description: Greatarrows used by the General Radahns during the festival of combat. These are in fact the many spears with which he was stabbed by the Cleanrot Knights.Imbued with Radahn's gravitational power.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Radahn's soldiers.
items.effect: Summons two Radahn Soldier spirits

items.name: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Helm
items.description: Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

items.name: Radiant Baldachin's Blessing
items.description: Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity. Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor. It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.
items.effect: Uses FP to temporarily raise poise

items.name: Radiant Gold Mask
items.description: A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Strenthens Golden Order incantations. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit. "To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

items.name: Ragged Armor
items.description: Armor pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Ragged Armor.

items.name: Ragged Gloves
items.description: Gauntlets pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Hat
items.description: Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Hat (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Ragged Hat.

items.name: Ragged Loincloth
items.description: Greaves pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Raging Wolf Armor
items.description: Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

items.name: Raging Wolf Armor (altered)
items.description: Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Rainbow Stone
items.description: Ruin Fragment that has undergone some simple processing.
items.effect: Shines with colored light when placed, serving as a guide

items.name: Rainbow Stone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones tipped with chips of Rainbow Stone. Colored lights shine at the point of impact.

items.name: Rancor Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by the ancient death hex. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to spawn vengeful spirits that chase down foes. In times of old, the dead were burned with ghostflame, and from those cinders arose vengeful spirits.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw to summon vengeful spirits.

items.name: Rancorcall
items.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.
