items.effect: Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes

items.name: Ranni's Dark Moon
items.description: Legendary sorcery associated with the Carian queen.
items.effect: Incarnate a cold, dark moon and launch it at foes.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

items.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
items.description: Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey. Worn by the assassin Ravenmount.

items.name: Raptor Talons
items.description: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades, wielded by the assassins of Ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

items.name: Raw Meat Dumpling
items.description: A pungent raw meatball, made succulent by virtue of being on the verge of turning.
items.effect: Restores HP but causes poison buildup

items.name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three Raya Lucaria soldiers.
items.effect: Summons three Raya Lucaria soldier spirits

items.name: Raya Lucarian Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Helm
items.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Its brow adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Robe
items.description: Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep blue garb along with their vows of virtue and austerity. But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

items.name: Recusant Finger
items.description: Item for online play.
items.effect: Attempts invasion of other player's world

items.name: Red Branch Shortbow
items.description: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.  A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.

items.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
items.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.

items.name: Red-feathered Branchsword
items.description: A talisman adorned with red feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.
items.effect: Raises attack power when HP is low.

items.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
items.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.

items.name: Redmane Greatshield
items.description: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

items.name: Redmane Knight Armor
items.description: Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

items.name: Redmane Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Redmane Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

items.name: Redmane Knight Greaves
items.description: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Redmane Knight Ogha
items.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Ogha, the Redmane Knight. Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned. The longest-serving member of the Redmane Knights, Ogha studied techniques to manipulate gravity alongside Radahn. May use a rain of gravitational arrows in response to a war cry, but only once.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

items.name: Redmane Surcoat
items.description: Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.

items.name: Reduvia
items.description: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curled blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

items.name: Regal Omen Bairn
items.description: Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line.  Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.
items.effect: Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase that foes

items.name: Regalia Of Eochaid
items.description: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.  Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies

items.name: Rejection
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
items.effect: Produces a shockwave that pushes away foes.

items.name: Rejuvenating Boluses
items.description: Black boluses made of cave moss. Craftable item.
items.effect: Alleviates death blight buildup

items.name: Remembrance Of Hoarah Loux
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Black Blade
items.description: Remembrance of Maliketh, the Black Blade, hewn into the
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Blasphemous
items.description: Remembrance of the warrior I-Ioarah Loux, hewn into the
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Dragonlord
items.description: Remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Fire Giant
items.description: Remembrance of Fire Giant, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Full Moon Queen
items.description: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Grafted
items.description: Remembrance of Godrick, the Grafted, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Lichdragon
items.description: Remembrance of Lichdragon Fortissax, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Naturalborn
items.description: Remembrance of Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, hewn into the Erdtree.  The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Omen King
items.description: Remembrance of Morgott, the Omen King, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Though born one of the graceless Omen, Morgott took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector. He loved not in return, for he was never loved, but nevertheless, love it he did.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Regal Ancestor
items.description: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Spirit, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Rot Goddess
items.description: Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Remembrance Of The Starscourge
items.description: Remembrance of Starscourge Radahn, hewn into the Erdtree.
items.effect: Take the power of its namesake via Finger Reader

items.name: Rennala's Full Moon
items.description: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.
items.effect: Incarnate a full moon and launch it at foes

items.name: Rickety Shield
items.description: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

items.name: Rift Shield
items.description: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

items.name: Rimed Crystal Bud
items.description: A young plant, frozen into a crystal before it could mature. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Rimed Rowa
items.description: A berry-like fruit, thought to be the original strain of Rowa. Material used for crafting items. Found in frigid highlands.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Ringed Finger
items.description: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.

items.name: Ripple Blade
items.description: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

items.name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
items.description: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

items.name: Ritual Pot
items.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Special item with greater durability than a cracked pot.
items.effect: Container required for crafting ritual pot items

items.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
items.description: A talisman patterned after shields used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.
items.effect: Raises defense when HP is at maximum.

items.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
items.description: A talisman patterned after swords used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.
items.effect: Raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

items.name: Rivers Of Blood
items.description: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.  When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

items.name: Riveted Wooden Shield
items.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

items.name: Rock Blaster
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Thurst staff into ground to emit a massive shockwave

items.name: Rock Sling
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.
items.effect: Summons rocks from the earth and sends its flying

items.name: Rogier's Rapier
items.description: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

items.name: Roiling Magma
items.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir. Fires a lump of condensed magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion. After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.
items.effect: Fires lump of magma that explodes after delay

items.name: Rold Medallion
items.description: Conjoined split medallion depicting the Flame Peak. Brandishing the medallion activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants. The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.
items.effect: Operates Grand Lift of Rold

items.name: Ronin's Armor
items.description: Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

items.name: Ronin's Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Ronin's Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

items.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

items.name: Ronin's Greaves
items.description: Greaves of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

items.name: Root Resin
items.description: Resin secreted from the roots of the Great tree. Material used in crafting items. The roots of the Great tree drive far and wide through the earth of the Lands Between. They were once entwined with the roots of the Erdtree, or so they say.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Roped Fetid Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of effluents is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of deadly poison. Beware though; those who carry these pots will slowly accumulate poison in their own bodies. Push someone in a privy; expect to get dung on your hands.
items.effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of deadly poison

items.name: Roped Fire Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot.
items.effect: Throw behind to inflict fire damage.

items.name: Roped Holy Water Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw behind to inflict holy damage

items.name: Roped Oil Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of oil-infused materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to soak them in oil, making them heavily susceptible to fire damage.
items.effect: Throw behind to douse enemies in oil

items.name: Roped Poison Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. A cocktail of poisonous materials is sealed inside, and a short rope that aids throwing has been secured around the pot. Throw at rearward enemies to cause buildup of poison.
items.effect: Throw behind to cause buildup of poison

items.name: Rosus' Axe
items.description: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need i of a guiding hand.

items.name: Rot Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of rotten materials.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting scarlet rot

items.name: Rot Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of scarlet wings. Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot.  The rot bubbles up from the Swamp of Aeonia, and eats away at life like a vicious plague.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to cause buildup of scarlet rot.

items.name: Rotbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with rot. Afflicts targets with scarlet rot. Craftable item.

items.name: Rotbone Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with rot. Afflicts targets with scarlet rot. Craftable item. The fletching adds distance to the arrow's flight.

items.name: Rotbone Bolt
items.description: Bolt carved from animal bone. The tip is daubed with rot. Afflicts targets with scarlet rot. Craftable item.

items.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
items.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike. Skill: Braggart's Roar Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.

items.name: Rotten Breath
items.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Channels dragon to spew scarlet rot breath

items.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
items.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
items.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
items.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
items.description: Greaves wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
items.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
items.description: Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot. The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak.

items.name: Rotten Greataxe
items.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

items.name: Rotten Staff
items.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.

items.name: Rotten Stray Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray. Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot.  Through it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot
items.effect: Summon rotten stray spirit

items.name: Round Shield
items.description: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.

items.name: Rowa Fruit
items.description: Berry-like red fruits that grow in shrubs. Material used for crafting items. Easily found everywhere in the Lands Between, it is primarily used in preserved foods.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Rowa Raisin
items.description: Preparation of dried Rowa fruit.
items.effect: On horseback, feed to spectral steed to restore HP

items.name: Royal Greatsword
items.description: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

items.name: Royal House Scroll
items.description: Sorcery scroll of the Carian royal family, the heads of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Give to a learned sorcerer to acquire new sorceries

items.name: Royal Knight Armor
items.description: Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Royal Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

items.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Knight Greaves
items.description: Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Knight Helm
items.description: Silver helm of Loretta, a Knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Royal Remains Armor
items.description: Armory graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

items.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

items.name: Royal Remains Greaves
items.description: Greaves graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

items.name: Royal Remains Helm
items.description: Helm graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

items.name: Ruin Fragment
items.description: Stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies. These shards of stone are believed to have once been part of a temple in the sky. They glow with a faint light from within.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items.

items.name: Ruins Greatsword
items.description: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbords its destructive power.

items.name: Ruler's Mask
items.description: Mask in the image of a wizened sage. Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation. Increases faith. Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality. One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

items.name: Ruler's Robe
items.description: Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation. Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.

items.name: Rune Arc
items.description: A shard of the shattered Elden Ring.
items.effect: Grants the blessing of an equipped rune upon use

items.name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
items.description: A special crystallization formed within a tear of life over the course of many moons. Causes concoction to explode when taken in mixed physick. A dangerous form of crystal tear which possesses absolutely no medicinal qualities. A lesson said to be learned the hard way for some; faith can be a volatile matter, after all.
items.effect: Causes concoction to explode in mixed physick

items.name: Rusted Anchor
items.description: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. While the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Kird, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.

items.name: Rusty Key
items.description: Rusted iron key.
items.effect: Opens a locked door in Stormveil Castle

items.name: Rykard's Rancor
items.description: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
items.effect: Releases searing spirits that repeatedly explode after delay

items.name: Sacramental Bud
items.description: An immature bud containing fresh blood. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Sacred Crown Helm
items.description: Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Who is it that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

items.name: Sacred Order Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Enchanted by incantations of the Golden Order. Consumes FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy holy damage. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death, even preventing them from rising again. The Golden Order has no mercy for those who trespass beyond life's bounds.
items.effect: Uses FP. Throw at enemies to inflict heavy holy damage.

items.name: Sacred Relic Sword
items.description: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

items.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
items.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart with a blessed glow.
items.effect: Raises holy attack, but lowers damage negation.

items.name: Sacred Tear
items.description: Blessing of the Erdtree, worshiped in the churches of all lands; this
items.effect: Improves Sacred Flask's potency

items.name: Sacrificial Axe
items.description: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.

items.name: Sacrificial Twig
items.description: A talisman fashioned from a dried twig, so slender that it might snap at the slightest touch.
items.effect: Will be lost on death in place of runes.

items.name: Sage Hood
items.description: A burgundy pointed hood. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

items.name: Sage Robe
items.description: Thick burgundy robe. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

items.name: Sage Trousers
items.description: Thick burgundy trousers. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

items.name: Sancrified Whetblade
items.description: Sanctified whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife. When applying an affinity using physical or golden-type ashes of war, an additional affinity of sacred or lightning can be chosen.
items.effect: Grants choice of affinity upgrade to weapon.

items.name: Sanctuary Stone
items.description: A rare piece of stone fragment found near places where ruins have fallen from the sky. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
items.description: Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
items.description: Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.

items.name: Scale Armor
items.description: Armor reinforced with small metal scales. The cape covering the shoulders is made with treated rock lizard skin, and provides ample protection against fire.

items.name: Scaled Armor
items.description: Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks.

items.name: Scaled Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Scaled Armor

items.name: Scaled Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

items.name: Scaled Greaves
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

items.name: Scaled Helm
items.description: Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

items.name: Scarlet Aeonia
items.description: Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.
items.effect: Creates a giant flower that explodes with scarlet rot.

items.name: Scarlet Tabard
items.description: Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot. Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army

items.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
items.description: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.

items.name: Scepter Of The All-knowing
items.description: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All- Knowing's hand grasps for it.

items.name: Scholar's Armament
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Enchants right-hand armament with magic damage

items.name: Scholar's Shield
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Enhances left-handed shield damage negation

items.name: Scimitar
items.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

items.name: Scorpion Kite Shield
items.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.

items.name: Scorpion's Stinger
items.description: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.

items.name: Scouring Black Flame
items.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles. Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range. The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.
items.effect: Sweeps area before caster with black flame

items.name: Scriptstone
items.description: Ruin fragment inscribed with letters.  Craftable item. Reveals additional messages from other worlds. Words are gregarious things, drawn to one another much as people are.
items.effect: Reveals more messages from other worlds

items.name: Scripture Wooden Shield
items.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

items.name: Scythe
items.description: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.  In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.

items.name: Seedbed Curse
items.description: Curse grown on a corpse killed and defiled by the Dung Eater. A tender pox afflicted with omen horns.
items.effect: Curse grown on a body defiled by a Dung Eater

items.name: Seluvis's Introduction
items.description: Scroll bearing a royal coat of arms.
items.effect: Letter of introduction addressed to Sellen

items.name: Seluvis's Potion
items.description: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis containing a cloudy tonic of bluish black.
items.effect: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis

items.name: Sentry's Torch
items.description: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

items.name: Serpent Arrow
items.description: Arrow carved to resemble a flying snake. Used in tandem with the Serpent Bow.

items.name: Serpent Bow
items.description: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

items.name: Serpent-god's Curved Sword
items.description: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.

items.name: Serpent-hunter
items.description: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.

items.name: Serpentbone Blade
items.description: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The denely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison

items.name: Sewer-gaol Key
items.description: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.
items.effect: Unlocks sewer-gaol door beneath Leyndell

items.name: Sewing Needle
items.description: A large sewing needle, curved like a fang. Boc the demi-human's prized possession.
items.effect: Boc the demi-human's prized sewing needle

items.name: Shabriri Grape
items.description: A yellowing, oozing eyeball of the infirm. The surface is shriveled, and the inside is squishy, not unlike a large, overly-ripe grape.
items.effect: Yellow, oozing eyeball of the infirm

items.name: Shabriri's Woe
items.description: Disturbing likeness of a man whose eyes have been gouged out. The corners of his mouth are upturned in an almost flirtatious manner.
items.effect: Constantly attracts enemies' aggression

items.name: Shadow Bait
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' sewants, who once served as the
items.effect: Creates shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build

items.name: Shaman Furs
items.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

items.name: Shaman Leggings
items.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

items.name: Shamshir
items.description: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.

items.name: Shard Of Alexander
items.description: Shard of the late Alexander, a shattered warrior jar.
items.effect: Greatly boosts the attack power of skills.

items.name: Shard Spiral
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Fire twin spiraling projectiles

items.name: Shatter Earth
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack. A Stonedigger sorcery used by the glintstone miners of the crystal tunnel. At the academy, use of this sorcery was a stigma that marked out failed scholars.
items.effect: Thrust staff into ground to emit a shockwave

items.name: Shattering Crystal
items.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency. The Crystalians are inorganic beings, yet they live. They cleave close to the ideals of the primeval current, and as such, they are revered guests of the sorcerers.
items.effect: Creates crystal mass that shatters in forward burst

items.name: Shattershard Arrow
items.description: Arrows whittled from animal bones tipped with a shard of crystal. Creates a resonating noise at the point of impact.

items.name: Shattershard Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones tipped with a shard of crystal. Creates a resonating noise at the point of impact.

items.name: Shield Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of magically resonant materials. Craftable item.
items.effect: Boosts guarding ability and all damage negation.

items.name: Shield Of The Guilty
items.description: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands. Venerating the repose of the soul, this shield boosts focus. The briars can be used to attack foes.

items.name: Shining Horned Headband
items.description: Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

items.name: Short Spear
items.description: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

items.name: Short Sword
items.description: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

items.name: Shotel
items.description: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.

items.name: Siluria's Tree
items.description: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.

items.name: Silver Firefly
items.description: Firefly that gives off a silvery light. Material used in crafting items. Found near bodies of cold water untouched by sunlight. The light of fireflies is believed to have an alluring magic. Silver light is considered to invite riches.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Silver Mirrorshield
items.description: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.

items.name: Silver-pickled Fowl Foot
items.description: Four-toed foot of a fowl, pickled in a silvery medicinal solution.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts item discovery (+50)

items.name: Silver Tear Husk
items.description: A hardened husk shed by a formless life form known as the Silver Tear, found in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items. The Silver Tear makes mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation. Perhaps, one day, it will be reborn a lord...
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Silver Tear Mask
items.description: Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk. Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power. To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.

items.name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of a skeletal bandit.
items.effect: Summons skeletal bandit spirit

items.name: Skeletal Mask
items.description: Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face. Worn by the assassin's of Ravensmount.

items.name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen.
items.effect: Summons two skeletal militiaman spirits

items.name: Sleep Pot
items.description: Craftable item prepared using a cracked pot. Filled with the incantations of St. Trina. Consumes FP. Throw at enemy to release a purple, soporific haze. Like a lullaby, or a quagmire, it irresistibly draws its victims down into sleep. Sweet dreams.
items.effect: Emits a Soporific purple haze

items.name: Sleepbone Arrow
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a water lily tincture. Afflicts targets with drowsiness. Craftable item.

items.name: Sleepbone Arrow Fletched
items.description: Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is daubed with a water lily tincture. Afflicts targets with drowsiness. Craftable item. The addition of fletching enables more precise shots that can travel farther.

items.name: Sliver Of Meat
items.description: A slice of thinly carved beast flesh. Material used for crating items. Found by hunting herbivorous beast. The dried meat toughens the constitution.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Slumbering Egg
items.description: Owl eggs that will never hatch. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Small Golden Effigy
items.description: Online multiplayer item. Sends a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer to a nearby summoning pool. In cooperative multiplayer, you will be summoned to another world to help defeat the area boss.
items.effect: Send co-operative sign to summoning pool

items.name: Small Red Effigy
items.description: Item for online play. Sends a competitive sign to a nearby summoning pool. In competitive multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned.
items.effect: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool

items.name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
items.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion.
items.effect: Spews magic breath of Glintstone Dragon Smarag from above

items.name: Smithing Stone [1]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A shard found in plenty.
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +3.

items.name: Smithing Stone [2]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large shard found in plenty. Strengthens armaments up to +6. Smithing stone is found throughout the Lands Between, and mining galleries built to excavate it can be found everywhere
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +6.

items.name: Smithing Stone [3]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A particularly hard specimen.
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +9.

items.name: Smithing Stone [4]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A large and particularly hard specimen.
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +12.

items.name: Smithing Stone [5]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armamemnts. A rare specimen, it is tinged with gold.
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +15.

items.name: Smithing Stone [6]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. A larger rare specimen, it is tinged with gold.
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +18.

items.name: Smithing Stone [7]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variey of armaments. Found in a polar region, it is semi-vitrified.
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +21.

items.name: Smithing Stone [8]
items.description: Stone used to smith a variety of armaments. Found in a polar region, it is semi-vitrified
items.effect: Reinforce armaments up to +24.

items.name: Smoldering Butterfly
items.description: An eternally burning butterfly found near wildfires and elsewhere. Material used for crafting items. Serves as the kindling for a number of items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Smoldering Shield
items.description: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava. Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.

items.name: Snow Witch Hat
items.description: Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery. Strengthens cold sorcery. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Snow Witch Robe
items.description: Witch's robe in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Snow Witch Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Snow Witch Robe

items.name: Snow Witch Skirt
items.description: Witch's skirt in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Soap
items.description: A plant-based soap made from mushroom juice. Craftable item.
items.effect: Removes filth and accumulations on the body

items.name: Soft Cotton
items.description: A soft but sturdy cotton formed from splitting open Rowa fruit in a particular manner. Craftable item.
items.effect: Temporarily reduces fall damage and sound

items.name: Soldier's Crossbow
items.description: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

items.name: Soldjars Of Fortune Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire. "Tell the others—tell them how brightly a fire jar burns."
items.effect: Summons three little living jar spirits

items.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
items.description: Ancient dragonrock smithing stone drained of color. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +10

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [1]
items.description: Shard of smithing stone drained of color. Strengthens special armaments to +1. Special armements with unique characteristics cannot be strengthened with colored smithing stones. Number of steps and amount strengthened differ from standard equipment.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +1.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [2]
items.description: Large shard of smithing stone drained of color. Strengthens special armaments to +2. Special armements with unique characteristics cannot be strengthened with colored smithing stones. Number of steps and amount strengthened differ from standard equipment.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +2.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [3]
items.description: Hard smithing stone drained of color.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +3.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [4]
items.description: Large hard smithing stone drained of color.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +4.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [5]
items.description: Gold smithing stone drained of color.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +5.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [6]
items.description: Large gold smithing stone drained of color.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +6.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [7]
items.description: Polar smithing stone drained of color.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +7.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8]
items.description: Large polar smithing stone drained of color.
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +8.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9]
items.description: Ancient smithing stone drained of color
items.effect: Reinforce special armaments to +9.

items.name: Soporific Grease
items.description: Solidified grease made from a mixture of light-purple materials. Craftable item.
items.effect: Coats armament, inflicting sleep

items.name: Sorcerer Leggings
items.description: Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

items.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
items.description: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

items.name: Spark Aromatic
items.description: Art of the perfumers who fought In the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to broadly scatter sparks in a wide arc straight ahead. Though fire was prohibited to those who served the Erdtree, this rule was forgotten as the war drew ever on.
items.effect: Uses FP to broadly scatter sparks in a wide arc straight ahead

items.name: Spear
items.description: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

items.name: Spear Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a spear and a soldier. Enhances the counterattacks that are unique to thrusting weapons.
items.effect: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons

items.name: Speckled Hardtear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction temporarily raises all resistances and heals all status ailments.
items.effect: Boosts resistance and heals status in mixed physick.

items.name: Spectral Steed Whistle
items.description: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.
items.effect: Summon and ride spectral steed Torrent.

items.name: Spellblade's Gloves
items.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

items.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
items.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

items.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
items.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

items.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Spellblade's Traveling Attire

items.name: Spellblade's Trousers
items.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman
items.description: Talisman depicting a blue ancient dragon. Boosts magic damage negation.
items.effect: Boosts magical damage negation.

items.name: Spellproof Dried Liver
items.description: Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a blue medicinal
items.effect: Temporarily boosts magic damage negation

items.name: Spiked Caestus
items.description: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.

items.name: Spiked Club
items.description: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

items.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Enhances charged attacks for a time in mixed physick

items.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
items.description: Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield"

items.name: Spiked Spear
items.description: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capaable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soliders employed by sorcerers.

items.name: Spiralhorn Shield
items.description: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.

items.name: Spirit Calling Bell
items.description: A bell capable of summoning various spirits from ashen remains. It usually requires FP to use.
items.effect: Bell that summons various spirits from ashen items

items.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish.
items.effect: Summons spirit jellyfish.

items.name: Spiritflame Arrow
items.description: Arrow set alight with ghostflame before firing.Deals magic damage while also afflictingfoes with frost.

items.name: St. Trina's Torch
items.description: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.  The light-purple flame induces sleep.

items.name: Staff Of Loss
items.description: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism. This staff is only capable of casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

items.name: Staff Of The Avatar
items.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.

items.name: Staff Of The Guilty
items.description: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.

items.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
items.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Greatly raises robustness. (Robustness governs resistance to blood loss and frost.)  Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.
items.effect: Greatly raises robustness

items.name: Stanching Boluses
items.description: Red boluses made from cave moss Craftable item. Alleviates impending blood loss Blood loss escalates gradually, causing great damage once the threshold is reached. Take one of these in timely fashion to avoid such an event.
items.effect: Alleviates impending blood loss

items.name: Star Fist
items.description: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.  Used in brutal games of pugilism.

items.name: Star Shower
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.
items.effect: Fires six shooting stars that pursue foes

items.name: Stargazer Heirloom
items.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of a queen. Raises intelligence.
items.effect: Raises intelligence by 5.

items.name: Starlight
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.effect: Creates star light to illuminate surroundings

items.name: Starlight Shards
items.description: An ephemeral sliver that gives off a pale blue glow.
items.effect: Use to gradually recover FP

items.name: Stars Of Ruin
items.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Lusat, primeval sorcerers.
items.effect: Fire twelve dark shooting stars that pursue foes

items.name: Starscourge Greatsword
items.description: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

items.name: Starscourge Heirloom
items.description: A talisman engraved with a scene from a heroic tale. Raises strength.
items.effect: Raises strength

items.name: Steel-wire Torch
items.description: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.

items.name: Stimulating Boluses
items.description: Light-purple boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item. Alleviates buildup of sleep. Sleep accumulates gradually, causing sudden fogginess and loss of FP once the threshold is reached, even if it does not force the afflicted into true slumber. Take one of these into timely fashion to avoid such events.
items.effect: Alleviates buildup of sleep

items.name: Stone Club
items.description: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

items.name: Stone Of Gurranq
items.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
items.effect: Hurls a boulder before the caster

items.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Make attacks more likely to break enemy stances in a mixed physick

items.name: Stonesword Key
items.description: A sword-shaped stone key.
items.effect: Use to break one imp statue seal

items.name: Stormhawk Axe
items.description: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, wioth its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.

items.name: Stormhawk Deenh
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk.
items.effect: Summons spirit of Stormhawk Dreenh

items.name: Stormhawk Feather
items.description: A feather from a hawk that lived as one with the storms. Material used for crafting items. These feathers, enveloped in swirling winds, are often used for arrow fletching.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Strength-knot Crystal Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Temporarily boosts strength in mixed physick

items.name: String
items.description: Boasting no special qualities, this is merely a goodly length of string.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Strip Of White Flesh
items.description: Thin strips of flesh taken from a bloodless creature. Material used for crafting items. The dried meat toughens the constitution, boosting resistance. It's known for its long-lasting effect.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Sun Realm Shield
items.description: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

items.name: Surge, O Flame!
items.description: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.
items.effect: Incinerates area before caster with stream of fire

items.name: Swarm Of Flies
items.description: A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power. Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion. The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.
items.effect: Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster

items.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
items.effect: Swiftly fires magic projectiles from glintstone

items.name: Sword Of Milos
items.description: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopside saw-blade. Milos was indersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly gortesque.

items.name: Sword Of Night And Flame
items.description: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sroveres, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

items.name: Sword Of St Trina
items.description: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

items.name: Tailoring Tools
items.description: A portable set of tailoring tools.
items.effect: Enables armor adjustment at sites of grace

items.name: Taker's Cameo
items.description: A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor.
items.effect: Restores HP upon defeating enemies

items.name: Talisman Pouch
items.description: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader.
items.effect: Increases Talisman equip slots.

items.name: Tarnished Golden Sunflower
items.description: A large flower that blooms facing the Erdtree. Material used for crafting items. Found near Minor Erdtrees.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Tarnished's Furled Finger
items.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.
items.effect: Creates cooperative multiplayer summon sign.

items.name: Tarnished's Wizened Finger
items.description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Messages menu.) Use to write messages. Your messages will be conveyed to other worlds, allowing other players to read them. A finger of corpse wax, so emaciated the bone is visible. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.
items.effect: Used to write messages.

items.name: Taunter's Tongue
items.description: Item for online play. Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)
items.effect: Lures in invanders.

items.name: Telescope
items.description: Astrology tool used by members of the Carian royal family. Part of a larger instrument, removed and stolen away. Allows the viewer to better see faraway things. During the age of the Erdtree, Carian astrology withered on the vine. The fate once writ in the night skies had been fettered by the Golden Order.
items.effect: Allows viewer to see faraway things

items.name: Terra Magicus
items.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Draws an academy sigil upon the ground, raising the magic strength of those within. Once, the sigil would be cast from the highest belfry of the academy, covering the entire institution's grounds. This spell allows such vivid experience of spell—casting success, it turns many a fledgling into a true sorcerer in a flash of newfound understanding.
items.effect: Raises the magic strength of those within the sigil

items.name: Thawfrost Boluses
items.description: Ice-hued boluses made from cave moss. Craftable item.
items.effect: Alleviates buildup of frost

items.name: The Flame Of Frenzy
items.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
items.effect: Emits burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

items.name: The Stormhawk King
items.description: Ashes of a hawk revered by all others as sovereign back in the days when Stormveil's winds still raged like no other. This ancient monarch is proud however, refusing to answer anyone's summons.
items.effect: Ashes of a hawk which heeds no summons.

items.name: Theodorix's Magma
items.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix. Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack. The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.
items.effect: Spews magma breath of Theodorix from above

items.name: Thin Beast Bones
items.description: Thin, hard beast bones. Material used for crafting items. Found by hunting beasts.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Thops's Barrier
items.description: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.
items.effect: Erect a magic forcefield to deflect spells

items.name: Thorned Whip
items.description: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

items.name: Thorny Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground. Can be mixed in the Flask of Wondrous Physick. The resulting concoction makes consecutive attacks grow stronger the longer they continue. However, the effect lasts only for a short time.
items.effect: Makes consecutive attacks grow stronger in mixed physick.

items.name: Through And Through
items.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Through and Through: Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies."Usable on greatbows.

items.name: Throwing Dagger
items.description: Short dagger for throwing.
items.effect: Throw at enemies to inflict damage

items.name: Tibia's Summons
items.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.
items.effect: Summons Those Who Live in Death

items.name: Torch
items.description: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

items.name: Torchpole
items.description: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

items.name: Toxic Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom covered in toxic mold that grows in rotten lands. Material used for crafting items.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Traveler's Boots
items.description: Light yet sturdy leather boots.

items.name: Traveler's Clothes
items.description: Light yet sturdy clothes.

items.name: Traveler's Gloves
items.description: Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

items.name: Traveler's Hat
items.description: Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

items.name: Traveler's Manchettes
items.description: Light yet sturdy leather manchettes.

items.name: Traveler's Slops
items.description: Slops of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Boots
items.description: Boots worn by traveling maidens.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Gloves
items.description: Gloves worn by traveling maidens.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Hood
items.description: Hood worn by traveling maidens.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Robe
items.description: Robe worn by traveling maidens. Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Robe (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Traveling Maiden Robe

items.name: Tree-and-beast Surcoat
items.description: Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an emblem of the golden lineage. Both are symbols of glory now past.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
items.description: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Tree Sentinel Armor

items.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
items.description: Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Greaves
items.description: Golden greaves of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Helm
items.description: Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

items.name: Tree Surcoat
items.description: Blue surcoat draped over chainmail. The tree insignia emblazoned on the front depicts the Erdtree, and is a design beloved throughout the Lands Between.

items.name: Treespear
items.description: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals only holy damage.  Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

items.name: Trina's Lily
items.description: A pale purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A symbol of faith in St. Trina. Dulls the senses, preventing agitation.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Triple Rings Of Light
items.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. A gift from the young Ivliquella to his father, Radagon.
items.effect: Fire three rings of light before the caster

items.name: Troll Knight's Sword
items.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

items.name: Troll's Golden Sword
items.description: Sword given to the giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.

items.name: Troll's Hammer
items.description: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.  Trolls are descended form the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distance past, smithing was considered divine.

items.name: Turtle Neck Meat
items.description: A splendid, lengthy cut of turtle neck meat. Material used for crafting items. Turtle meat is said to boost virility, but none in the Lands Between seem to have much appetite for it these days. In Lands Between, the urge to reproduce has waned long ago.
items.effect: Material used for crafting items

items.name: Twiggy Cracked Tear
items.description: A crystal tear formed slowly over the ages where the Erdtree's bounty falls to the ground.
items.effect: Briefly stop rune loss on death in mixed physick

items.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
items.description: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds. At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.

items.name: Twinblade
items.description: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield, and requires high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is enabled  with dual-handed spinning attacks.

items.name: Twinblade Talisman
items.description: A talisman depicting a twinblade and a confessor. Enhances the final hit ending a chain of attacks.
items.effect: Enhances final hit of chain attacks.

items.name: Twinned Armor
items.description: Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

items.name: Twinned Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Twinned Armor

items.name: Twinned Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

items.name: Twinned Greaves
items.description: Greaves depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

items.name: Twinned Helm
items.description: Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

items.name: Twinned Knight Swords
items.description: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.  Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

items.name: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
items.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina. Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kinds.

items.name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
items.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer.
items.effect: Summons Twinsage sorcerer spirit

items.name: Two Fingers Heirloom
items.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of the Two Fingers. Raises faith.
items.effect: Raises faith by 5.

items.name: Two Fingers Prayerbook
items.description: Prayerbook containing incantations of the Two Fingers. An item once entrusted to Tarnished worthy of lordship.
items.effect: Give to a learned cleric to acquire new incantations

items.name: Uchigatana
items.description: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade.  A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and ts slash attacks cause blood loss.

items.name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
items.description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold, snapped in half.
items.effect: Snapped intricate needle of unalloyed gold

items.name: Unendurable Frenzy
items.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.
items.effect: Emits violent burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes.

items.name: Unseen Blade
items.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Enchants armament held in right hand, making it completely invisible. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Used by Sellian assassins to present themselves as unarmed sorcerers.
items.effect: Makes right-hand armament completely invisible

items.name: Unseen Form
items.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Makes the caster semi-invisible. While on horseback, effect extends to cover the mount. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The Sellian assassins considered every option that aided their dirty work.
items.effect: Makes the caster semi-invisible

items.name: Uplifting Aromatic
items.description: An of the perfumers who fought in the Shattering. Craftable with a perfume bottle. Uses FP to raise the attack power of the user and nearby allies while also reducing the damage from one incoming attack by half. This aromatic has an extremely potent morale-raising effect that makes those accustomed to it fearless in the face of death. It was this influence that made the perfumers exceptional commanders.
items.effect: Boosts ally attack power and reduces incoming damage once.

items.name: Upper-class Robe
items.description: Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children. Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.

items.name: Urgent Heal
items.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.
items.effect: Heals a small amount of HP.

items.name: Urumi
items.description: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfold warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Armor
items.description: Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland.  Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Armor (altered)
items.description: Lighter version of the Vagabond Knight Armor

items.name: Vagabond Knight Gauntlets
